title: Brandenburgische Straße, Berlin
description:
The apartment is located on the 4th floor in the residential building at Brandenburgische Street 26 , which was designed by the architect Paul Baumgarten.  The apartment is compact, light-flooded and has a spacious living / dining area. The bedroom as well as the bathroom are also well designed and have that special something when you enter. 
The building, which was rebuilt in 2001 by adding a roof extension, contains an elevator and bicycle storage.
The living area has a dining table for 4 (four) people with floor to ceiling windows, the bathroom has natural light. The apartment has a modern fitted kitchen with a small table for 3 (three). 

The listed housing estate is located in the district Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf, district Wilmersdorf. Due to its proximity to Olivaer Platz, Kurfürstendamm, Adenauer Platz and Preußenpark, this is a very popular and urban residential area where the charm of the Berlin West has been preserved. Numerous shopping facilities and specialist shops as well as upscale gastronomy, with established pubs and bars are within walking distance. The underground stations Adenauer Platz and Konstanzer Straße are within short walking distance. The nearby city motorway also offers optimal transport connections.

Peaceful sleeping is guaranteed despite the very central location. The bedroom is bright and quiet (facing the courtyard) and has a comfortable double bed.
The modernly designed bathroom is equipped with a shower.
All rooms radiate cozy ambience, are brightly designed and are flooded with daylight.
The furniture shown in the pictures belongs to a previous tenant and gives you an idea about the furnishings.

title: Rudolstädter Straße, Berlin
description:
Hello :)

Welcome to your new home! The available room extends over a generous 19m2. It is fully furnished and equipped with a comfortable 160x200 bed, a desk with office chair, a spacious closet, a coat rack as well as matching lamps and a carpet.

Plenty of daylight streams into the room through the large, soundproofed double-glazed window. The large garden can be used by all residents of the house and offers plenty of space to relax in summer and winter. There is also a barbecue area.

The location could not be better - located directly at the Heidelberger Platz S+U station, it offers first-class connections. All universities and hotspots can be reached quickly and easily with the U3 underground line or the Ringbahn. The journey time to the FU is only 8 minutes, to the TU just 11 minutes.

There is a late-night supermarket practically on the corner of the street, and the municipal swimming pool is just across the street. Supermarkets and various shopping facilities are within a radius of just 200m.

The shared kitchen is not only fully equipped with modern appliances such as a Miele washing machine and dishwasher, but is also a place to exchange ideas and spend cooking evenings together. Not only culinary delights are created here, but also friendships.

The bathroom was recently renovated. It is important to us that every resident feels comfortable and at home. This also means that mutual agreements and respectful communication are an integral part of everyday life in our shared flat.

If you are looking for a home that is not only comfortable but also warm, then we look forward to welcoming you to our shared flat. We are looking forward to getting to know you a little better in a short introduction and creating a positive and harmonious living atmosphere together.

The monthly all-inclusive rent not only covers all utilities, but also includes normal electricity consumption and internet. This rental arrangement is more than just a room - it is an invitation to become part of a lively shared flat.

title: Riemenschneiderweg, Berlin
description:
This lovely and quiet apartment is situated on the top floor of a 1930's era Quadrangle.  Fully renovated, the apartment is currently set up with a single person or couple in mind. The bedroom has a 180cm bed, closet and small desk, as well as a small balcony.  A fully furnished living room with a Winter Garden style balcony, a newly renovated bathroom, and a fully outfitted kitchen including induction cooking and a dishwasher complete the rented area.
Although the apartment is conveniently close to the A100, the train station Südkreuz, and near the major city street Grazer Damm, it is extremely quiet.  The view from the Winter garden to the east looks out over the Nature Parkland “Schöneberg Südgelände” which is a great place for a walk or bike ride, or just to relax.
All necessary services are available within short walking distance, including groceries, restaurants, public transportation, bakery, playground, and a hospital. 
It is our wish is to make your stay in Berlin as comfortable as possible.  Kick off your shoes, unpack your bags and make yourself at home.

I look forward to welcoming you, and working together to make your stay as comfortable as possible.  If you need to leave before the end of your term, or have any other issues, I'm always available for discussion and mutually acceptable solutions.

Final Cleaning Fee of €150.

Cleaning services are available upon request, paid directly to the Cleaning Company.

----------

Diese schöne und ruhige Wohnung befindet sich in der obersten Etage eines Häuserblocks aus den 1930er Jahren. Die Wohnung ist frisch saniert, um Ihren Aufenthalt so angenehm wie möglich zu gestalten, und ist derzeit für eine einzelne Person oder ein Paar eingerichtet. Das große Schlafzimmer verfügt über ein 180 cm großes Bett, Schränke und einen Sekretär. Ein voll möbliertes Wohnzimmer mit Wintergarten, ein großzügiges Badezimmer und eine voll ausgestattete Küche mit Induktionskochfeld und Geschirrspüler bereichern ihren Aufenthalt.

Obwohl die Wohnung sehr praktisch in der Nähe der A100 und der Hauptstadtstraße Grazer Damm liegt, ist sie äußerst ruhig. Der Blick vom Wintergarten nach Osten, Richtung Mitte, eröffnet einen freien Blick über eine hübsche Gartenkolonie und den Naturpark Schöneberger Südgelände, der sich hervorragend zum Spazierengehen, Radfahren oder Entspannen eignet. 

Alle notwendigen Dienstleistungen, einschließlich Supermarkt, Restaurants, Bäckerei, öffentliche Verkehrsmittel, Spielplatz und ein Krankenhaus, sind nur einen kurzen Fußweg entfernt.

Wir freuen uns, Ihnen einen angenehmen Berlin-Aufenthalt zu ermöglichen und freuen uns, Sie in dem exklusiv ausgestatteten Domizil begrüßen zu können. Einfach Schuhe ausziehen, Tasche fallen lassen und Ihr neues Zuhause genießen.

Endreinigungsgebühr von €150.

Reinigungsdienste sind auf Anfrage erhältlich und werden direkt an die Reinigungsfirma gezahlt.

title: Rudolstädter Straße, Berlin
description:
Hello :)

Welcome to your new home! The available room extends over a generous 23m2. It is fully furnished and equipped with a comfortable 160x200 bed, a desk with office chair, a spacious closet, a coat rack as well as matching lamps and a carpet.

Plenty of daylight streams into the room through the large, soundproofed double-glazed window. The large garden can be used by all residents of the house and offers plenty of space to relax in summer and winter. There is also a barbecue area.

The location could not be better - located directly at the Heidelberger Platz S+U station, it offers first-class connections. All universities and hotspots can be reached quickly and easily with the U3 underground line or the Ringbahn. The journey time to the FU is only 8 minutes, to the TU just 11 minutes.

There is a late-night supermarket practically on the corner of the street, and the municipal swimming pool is just across the street. Supermarkets and various shopping facilities are within a radius of just 200m.

The shared kitchen is not only fully equipped with modern appliances such as a Miele washing machine and dishwasher, but is also a place to exchange ideas and spend cooking evenings together. Not only culinary delights are created here, but also friendships.

The bathroom was recently renovated. It is important to us that every resident feels comfortable and at home. This also means that mutual agreements and respectful communication are an integral part of everyday life in our shared flat.

If you are looking for a home that is not only comfortable but also warm, then we look forward to welcoming you to our shared flat. We are looking forward to getting to know you a little better in a short introduction and creating a positive and harmonious living atmosphere together.

The monthly all-inclusive rent not only covers all utilities, but also includes normal electricity consumption and internet. This rental arrangement is more than just a room - it is an invitation to become part of a lively shared flat.

title: Möckernstraße, Berlin
description:
Your very own hideaway in the middle of Berlin – enjoy wonderful Kreuzberg with Viktoriapark as your nearest neighbour! This spacious, airy apartment has everything you need.

Set in a stately 19th century building, the 105sqm apartment has easy access on the first half floor (Hochpaterre) and contains a spacious living room, a dining room, a relaxing bedroom, a work room that can be configured as an office, extra bedroom or music studio upon request, a fully functioning kitchen, a large bathroom with bathtub, a little secondary toilet, and an entrance with a large mirror wardrobe for storing all your clothes. You will not be disturbed by street noise here; the entire apartment faces a quiet and green back yard.

There are a great number of stores, cafes, restaurants and bars within walking distance, and of course beautiful Viktoriapark next door, with its famous waterfall running down Kreuzberg – the “mountain” from which this part of the city takes its name.

Marheineke Markthalle, the food market in Bergmannkiez, is also a source of endless culinary joy for vegetarians and meat-eaters alike, and if you prefer fast food, you have both Mustafa’s Gemüsekebap serving Berlin’s best and most famous kebab, and Curry36 dishing out equally legendary currywursts, along with seemingly endless other options.

At home you can of course enjoy stable internet from the couch or while working.

So please reach out! I am happy to answer any questions you might have, and I am looking forward to welcoming you here!

title: Gneisenaustraße, Berlin
description:
I am temporarily subletting my Berlin flat, as I will be living in London.

The flat is 56m2 and perfect for a couple (you can have it just for yourself as well of course). There's one bedroom and a larger room which combines the kitchen and living area. It has a nice parquet floor and is bright.
It's right next to the U7 stop, around the corner from Bergmannstr. and the Marheineke covered market. It's in the inner courtyard, very quiet, 4th floor.

The flat is fully functional, you'll be able to use all of the furniture that you see on the pictures. Whatever isn't to your taste could also go in the attic.
There is a washing machine and dryer as well as a dishwasher, oven and microwave.
I have reliable 50 Mps internet and you can use my desk setup with the screen. There is also a projector and bluetooth speakers in the living room.
You are also welcome to use my bike during your stay.

title: Großbeerenstraße, Berlin
description:
BEST LOCATION IN KREUZBERG :

The apartment is located in the unique, vibrant and popular district of Kreuzberg, which is right in the center of Berlin. You find a multicultural flair, vibrant street- and night life.  The surrounding is characterised by having many shops (Bergmannstraße etc.), cafes, terraces, pubs, clubs, museums, galleries, cinemas and restaurants. Only a stone throw away you will be in Mitte and find the Postdamer Platz ,Checkpoint Charlie and the Brandenburger Gate for your sightseeing and shopping tours.

Why you will love this place?:

- Located in a very popular and lively area in Kreuzberg, one of the most trendy neighbourhoods in Berlin. Very close from Mitte
- Well communicated: 3 mins walk to U7 and U6 line Mehringdamm, Bus 140 and M19 directly in front of the house
- Parks nearby. Right next to gorgeous Viktoria park and Gleisdreieck park which are perfect for a nice walk, exercise or have a beautiful view of Berlin on top of the hill of Viktoria park or chill next to the park's dreamy waterfall.
- 2 Supermarkets right in front of the house (Rewe and Edeka)
- Bakery downstairs
- The commune of Kreuzberg is right across the street
- Quiet neighbours

ABOUT THE FLAT:

* 2 room flat, 1 separate kitchen, 1 bathroom, 1 balcony. The second room is perfect to be used as a dining room or home office
* Flat is fully furnished and equipped, ready to be moved 
* Fully equipped kitchen with all you need including microwave, kettle, toaster, coffee machine.
* Bathroom with washing machine
* Big couch with storage space underneath. Can fold into a big sleeping couch
* new double windows - perfect isolation against noise and cold
* very fast wifi connection
* non-smoking flat!

Please note that if you rent the accommodation for less than 6 months and 1 day, an additional 7% VAT applies.

title: Obentrautstraße, Berlin
description:
This bright and modern 75 sqm apartment is located on the 6th floor of a well-maintained building in Kreuzberg, easily accessible by elevator. It features a smart two-room layout with a separate bedroom and a private balcony, offering a comfortable and airy living environment in a central location.

The apartment includes a welcoming living room with an open-plan, fully equipped kitchen, as well as a contemporary bathroom with both a shower and bathtub. Thoughtfully furnished throughout, it provides a practical and stylish space suited for urban living.

Situated in a vibrant and central part of Berlin, the area offers a great mix of urban convenience and local charm. You’ll find a variety of cafés, restaurants, and shops within walking distance, as well as nearby green spaces perfect for relaxing outdoors.

Excellent public transport connections make it easy to get around the city, with quick access to key districts and cultural hotspots. This location is ideal for anyone looking to enjoy the energy of Berlin while still having a comfortable place to unwind.

title: Friedrich-Karl-Straße, Berlin
description:
English version

Bright and beautifully furnished maisonette attic apartment with a south-facing roof terrace, located in the quiet rear building of a fully renovated Berlin Altbau at Friedrich-Karl-Straße , 12103 Berlin-Tempelhof.

The building combines classic Berlin Altbau charm with modern comfort. The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of the rear building and offers a wonderfully open and airy living atmosphere, with a maisonette layout, gallery level and a sunny private terrace.

The location is very well connected: the U6 underground line, bus M46 and bus lines 170 and 184 are all within walking distance. The S-Bahn Ring can be reached after only two U-Bahn stops. title: Hindenburgdamm, Berlin
description:
Hey, are you looking for a comfortable and convenient place to call a temporary home in Berlin? Look no further! We have a beautifully furnished room available in a newly refurbished shared flat located in the heart of Berlin Steglitz. It is fully furnished with a comfortable 140x200 bed, a desk with office chair and spacious closet. The large garden can be used by all residents of the house and offers a seating and barbecue area with plenty of space to relax. 

A highlight of the apartment is its location, here you are just a short ride away from the bustling city life and the peaceful greenery that Berlin is known for. Rathaus Steglitz is just a short walk away offering ideal connection to public transportation including S and U Bahn and many buses. The FU Berlin (Freie Universität Berlin) is just a short commute away (10 min by bike) making this the perfect spot for students! The Schloßstraße, one of the largest shopping areas in Berlin, is just a short walk-away with its numerous shops, cafés, restaurants and bars.
The flat has been freshly refurbished to the highest standards. Enjoy the sleek, modern bathroom and a brand-new kitchen equipped with a fringe, dishwasher and cooking facility.

It is important to us that every resident feels comfortable and at home. This also means that mutual agreements and respectful communication are an integral part of everyday life in our shared flat. We are looking forward to getting to know you a little better in a short introduction and creating a positive and harmonious living atmosphere together.

The monthly all-inclusive rent not only covers all utilities, but also includes normal electricity consumption and internet. Minimum rental period is 6 month, maximum rental period 24 months. 

Additional Features:
•	High-speed internet for seamless online classes and entertainment
•	Close to public transport, shops, supermarkets, cafes, and parks. The Schloßstraße is just a short walk away with its numerous shops, restaurants, bars and cafés. The close-by Berlin botanical gardens are ideal for relaxing walks and some time-out in the Green.

Discover the Vibrant Lifestyle of Berlin: A Hub for Living, Studying, and Working

Berlin, the dynamic capital of Germany, has firmly established itself as a city that seamlessly blends history, culture, and innovation. With its rich heritage, diverse population, and robust economy, Berlin has become a prime destination for individuals seeking a vibrant lifestyle while pursuing their educational and professional aspirations.

A Cultural Melting Pot: Berlin's allure lies in its diverse and inclusive atmosphere. It's a haven for artists, musicians, and creatives from all corners of the globe. The city's historic landmarks, such as the Brandenburg Gate and the Berlin Wall, stand as powerful reminders of its past while providing a backdrop for contemporary expression. The thriving arts scene, world-class museums, and countless galleries offer a continuous source of inspiration.

Educational Excellence: Berlin boasts an array of prestigious universities and research institutions that draw students and academics from around the world. Institutions like Humboldt University and the Technical University of Berlin provide cutting-edge research opportunities and a wide range of study programs. The city's commitment to education is further exemplified by its affordable tuition fees and numerous scholarships available to both local and international students.

title: Crellestraße, Berlin
description:
Quiet 1 double Bedroom Altbau Apartment with Balcony & Workspace – Schoenenerg Courtyard Oasis (Anmeldung Possible), fully furnished and relocation ready.

This is a gorgeous 1 double bedroom Altbau apartment with balcony overlooking a leafy green courtyard in central Schöneberg. Registration (Anmeldung) possible, all utilities and WiFi included. Ideal for professionals or couples relocating to Berlin.

The Apartment
This peaceful and beautifully renovated Altbau apartment is located on one of the most charming, leafy and quiet streets in the historic Crellekiez neighbourhood of Schöneberg.

Situated inside a restored late-19th-century building, the apartment retains classic Berlin architectural details including original wooden floors, high ceilings and elegant brass fittings, creating a warm and authentic Altbau atmosphere.

The apartment offers a rare and comfortable layout for its size, with a separate bedroom, and dedicated workspace with a window overlooking a leafy courtyard, as well as living room and bathroom, making it particularly well suited to remote working or longer stays in Berlin.

Layout:
• separate bedroom with double bed (160 cm)
• bright large living room including open kitchen
• modern bathroom
• balcony overlooking the courtyard
• hallway entrance area
Because the apartment faces a private green courtyard, it remains very quiet despite its central location.

Living Space & Balcony
The bright living room with open kitchen opens onto a charming wooden balcony through two full-length glass doors.
From here you look out over a leafy courtyard garden, where neighbours have created a small green oasis of flowers, plants and decorated balconies.
Both  provide pleasant spaces for eating, working or relaxing.
The atmosphere is peaceful and private while remaining in the centre of the city.

Bedroom & Dedicated Workspace
The cozy bedroom faces the same quiet courtyard and enjoys natural light and a calm atmosphere.
The room includes:
• a comfortable double bed (160 cm)
• storage space for clothes and hanging space for clothes
• a built-in desk by the window
The dedicated desk workspace makes the apartment especially comfortable for remote working professionals, researchers or creatives spending extended time in Berlin.

Kitchen & Bathroom
The modern open kitchen-living room is fully equipped for everyday cooking and dining. 
The modern spacious bathroom includes: shower, sink and mirror, cupboards and storage, washing machine, drying rack. A window provides natural light and ventilation.

Fully Furnished & Move-In Ready
The apartment is fully furnished and move-in ready, making it ideal for professionals or couples relocating to Berlin.

Included equipment:
Kitchen
• stove and oven
• refrigerator and freezer
• kettle and toaster
• cookware and cutlery

Household
• bed linens, pillows and blankets
• towels and hairdryer
• iron and ironing board
• vacuum cleaner and cleaning equipment
• smoke detector
• door intercom system

A clean, dry, lockable cellar storage space is also available for suitcases or larger items.

Location – Crellekiez / Schöneberg
Crellestrasse is one of the most beautiful historic streets in Schöneberg, known for its cobblestones, mature cherry trees and charming pedestrian areas.
The neighbourhood has long been part of Berlin’s creative history and was home to artists and writers including Christopher Isherwood, David Bowie and Marlene Dietrich.
Today the Crellekiez is known for its welcoming atmosphere, independent cafés, restaurants, art galleries and weekly farmers market.
The nearby Akazienkiez area offers even more cafés, bakeries, restaurants and shops within a short walk.

Transport Connections
The apartment is very well connected to public transport across Berlin. The location sits within Zone A, allowing quick travel throughout central Berlin.
Within approximately 5 minutes walk:
• U7 Kleistpark
• S1 Julius-Leber-Brücke
Nearby bus lines:
M48, M85, 104, 106, 187 and 204.

Shops & Everyday Essentials

• Denn’s Biomarkt
• Bio Insel
• Aldi
• Rewe

The surrounding streets also offer many independent food shops, bakeries and cafés.
On nearby Hauptstrasse you will also find major brands Rossmann, DM and TK Maxx, amongst many other shops.

• Contract renewable after the initial term

The apartment is managed professionally with transparent rental terms and reliable communication throughout the tenancy.

title: Motzener Straße, Berlin
description:
A Room for Rent in a Shared 2-Room Apartment – Motzener Strasse , 12277 Berlin

A bright and comfortable room with balcony access is available for rent in a well-maintained 2-room shared apartment (WG) located in Motzener Strasse, 12277 Berlin. The apartment is ideal for students or young professionals looking for a convenient and fully equipped living space.

The apartment is fully furnished and includes a modern kitchen equipped with all essential appliances, making everyday cooking easy and enjoyable. In addition, there is a bathroom with a shower and a washing machine, providing everything needed for comfortable daily living.

The monthly rent is an all-inclusive (warm rent) package, covering all utilities such as electricity, heating, water, and internet. The only additional cost is the German broadcasting fee (Rundfunkbeitrag), which is not included and will be shared equally between the two tenants.

The apartment is shared with one other person, offering a friendly and relaxed living atmosphere.

Key Features:

Fully equipped kitchen with all appliances
Room has balcony access
Bathroom with shower and washing machine
Internet included in rent
All utilities included (no hidden costs)
Only additional cost: shared broadcasting fee
Quiet and practical location in Berlin

The apartment is located on the fifth floor of the building. The building has 6 floors in total. We also offer an additional storage unit, which the 2 tenants can use together. That is included in the rental price and the storage is located in the basement of the building.

Car parking spaces can be rented for 80 € net (tenants pay no VAT).

Location & Surroundings:
The apartment is located in a quiet and well-connected area in the district of Marienfelde (Tempelhof-Schöneberg). The neighborhood offers a good balance between urban convenience and residential calm. Supermarkets, bakeries, and other everyday amenities are within easy reach.

Public transport connections are convenient, with nearby bus stops and S-Bahn access providing quick links to central Berlin. The area also offers green spaces and parks, ideal for outdoor activities, walking, or relaxing after a busy day.

The rent for the first month will be paid through HousingAnywhere. The deposit needs to be paid to us directly or via Housing Anywhere payments and should be received before the move-in date, in order to be able to receive the keys.

Thanks to its central location, the apartment is ideal for anyone visiting Berlin for the first time or looking for a well-connected place for a longer stay. The nearest subway station, Eisenacher Straße (U7 line), is only 150 meters away. From there, you can quickly reach the popular districts of Kreuzberg and Charlottenburg.
Additionally, Bayrischer Platz can be reached in just 8 minutes, where you can access the U4 line, which connects to other central areas such as Wilmersdorf, Zehlendorf, and Wittenbergplatz.

The bright apartment is located on the second floor of a quiet rear building. The open-plan living and sleeping area is furnished with a large bed (160x200 cm), a comfortable sofa, a stylish dining table, and a new desk with a matching chair. Fast Wi-Fi is of course included in the rent.

The hallway features a large built-in wardrobe that offers plenty of storage space. The fully equipped kitchen includes a washing machine, a large fridge with freezer, oven, toaster, kettle, coffee machinE, and a full set of dishes and cooking utensils. The modern bathroom is fitted with a shower.

The apartment was freshly renovated and tastefully modernized in October 2024: The new sofa, high-quality mattress, and stylish desk with chair add extra comfort and create a pleasant living atmosphere.

This apartment is ideal for expats, professionals, students, or digital nomads looking for a fully furnished, central, and quiet accommodation in Berlin with excellent transport connections. Registration at the local residents’ registration office is possible.

_________________
Die helle Wohnung liegt im zweiten Obergeschoss eines ruhigen Hinterhausgebäudes. Der Wohn- und Schlafbereich ist offen gestaltet und mit einem großen Bett (160x200 cm), einem bequemen Sofa, einem stilvollen Esstisch sowie einem neuen Schreibtisch mit passendem Stuhl ausgestattet. Schnelles WLAN ist selbstverständlich vorhanden und im Mietpreis inbegriffen.

Im Flur befindet sich ein großer Einbauschrank, der viel Stauraum bietet. Die Küche ist vollständig ausgestattet und verfügt über eine Waschmaschine, einen großen Kühlschrank mit Gefrierfach, einen Backofen, Toaster, Wasserkocher, eine Kaffeemaschine sowie komplettes Geschirr und Kochutensilien. Das moderne Badezimmer ist mit einer Dusche ausgestattet.

Die Wohnung wurde im Oktober 2024 frisch renoviert und geschmackvoll modernisiert: Das neue Sofa, die hochwertige Matratze sowie ein stilvoller Schreibtisch mit passendem Stuhl sorgen für zusätzlichen Komfort und ein angenehmes Wohngefühl.

Diese Wohnung eignet sich ideal für Expats, Berufstätige, Studierende oder digitale Nomaden, die eine voll ausgestattete, zentrale und ruhige Unterkunft in Berlin mit hervorragender Verkehrsanbindung suchen. Eine Anmeldung beim Einwohnermeldeamt ist möglich.

title: Kreuzbergstraße, Berlin
description:
Apartment

The apartment itself consists of a large room well-divided into:
- sleeping area (large bed with side table and side lamps)
- dining area (new table with 4 chairs)
- relaxing area (bright corner with a large sofa and a lower table)
3 new matching lamps (for ceiling, floor and bed) cannot be seen in the attached pictures.

The kitchen is fully equipped with refrigerator, modern cooking plate and oven, toaster, kettle, coffee machine and all the cooking equipment/utensils you may need.
The washing machine is the bathroom,
together with a modern shower and a couple of cabinets.

Location

This beautiful studio was newly renovated and is centrally located in Kreuzberg between two big city parks called Viktoria and Flaschenhal (southern part of Gleis-Dreieck Park). It lies at the first floor of a respectful old building and faces a quiet courtyard with trees. The large windows, the high ceiling and especially the wooden-tiled floor in the apartment, they all give a "ALTBAU" flair and special comfort.

title: Spilstraße, Berlin
description:
Bright 2-room apartment with separate bedroom near FU Berlin (Dahlem)

This fully furnished and tastefully decorated apartment offers both comfort and convenience in one of Berlin’s most pleasant residential areas.

Just a 2-minute walk from the nearest U-Bahn station and 1 minute from the bus stop, it provides excellent public transport connections. Restaurants, cafés, supermarkets, and small local shops are all within easy walking distance. The neighborhood is quiet and respectful, surrounded by greenery and close to the Grunewald forest, the Botanic Garden, and Grunewaldsee, offering plenty of space for outdoor activities and relaxation.

The apartment is bright and well laid out. A spacious living room with large windows opens directly onto a sunny rooftop terrace—perfect for enjoying fresh air or a morning coffee. The open-plan kitchen is fully equipped with modern appliances and all cooking essentials, and there is also a dedicated working area ideal for home office needs.

The bedroom is elegantly furnished with a comfortable double bed and a large wardrobe providing ample storage space. The bathroom, accessible from a practical entrance hall, features a bathtub, washing machine, and a window ensuring natural light and ventilation.

All furniture and fittings are of good quality, combining functionality with a clean, modern design. The apartment has a fast and reliable internet connection, and the building’s residents are quiet, friendly, and respectful.

This apartment offers a high standard of living and is an excellent choice for a mid- to long-term stay in Berlin. Registration (Anmeldung) is possible.

title: Methfesselstraße, Berlin
description:
The apartment is situated in a nice and beautiful neighbourhood just a few steps away from Victoriapark and a 10 minutes walk to Bergmannstrasse and Mehringdamm.

The apartment lies on the 5th floor of a 7-stories modern building with elevator and interesting shapes, built by a famous berliner architect. It consists of a bright elegant living room with winter garden + open kitchen + 2 bedrooms (one with double and one with single bed), bathroom, guest WC, store-room and 2 hallways.

In the living room you will find a convertible sofa, a huge smart-TV, an extendable wooden table, ceiling ventilator, 2 extra tables (one of glass and a lower one), storage units, nice lights and more. The "pointy" winter garden is also another place to chill, with plants that need to be watered only twice per month (or where to hang-dry clothes, being it warm and well-aired even in winter).
The kitchen is fully equipped with many devices (such as dishwasher, microwave, etc.) and with all cooking and eating utensils. The side-by-side refrigerator is obviously very big. One bedroom is larger and darker than the other and has lots of storage room. The second bedroom used to be an office and it still suits the need of home-workers (the plants can be moved to the winter garden). In the main bathroom there is a bath tub and a new washing machine (for up to 8 kilos wash). More storage room for shoes, coats and objects in the hallways.

The internet speed is very fast and reliable thanks to a fine contract with VODAFONE.

It is a perfect place to share with a friend or for a small family where to spend wonderful time inviting friends over for dinner and watching TV. All neighbours are friendly and kind but the house rules must be respected. 

Amazing part of Kreuzberg bordering with the districts of Tempelhof and Schöneberg.
The beautiful Victoria Park lies just beside while the famous Tempelhofer Park as well as other smaller parks are within walking distance (or by bike).
Parking the bike in the courtyard is safe.
In the neighbourhood there are 4 supermarkets, many restaurants, bars, bakeries, 3 pharmacies, small shops and much more.
The famous Bergmannstrasse is within walking distance (in the end of Methfesselstrasse).
The closest metro is the U6 "Platz der Luftbrücke" and there are 3 different bus stops going in all directions. U7 Mehringdamm is also reachable on foot. 

This is a sublet, most of the personal will be taken out .
Of course you are free to use utensils and everything you might need that you will find in the apartment.

The sublet is official and the building management will be informed so you can register at the authorities.

You can also register your car plate to park almost for free in the same road.

title: Holsteinische Straße, Berlin
description:
This bright and welcoming apartment has been recently renovated. The kitchen is brand-new, and most of the furniture has been newly added.

Situated on the second floor of a charming building surrounded by tall trees, the apartment offers a peaceful retreat in the heart of the city.

The living room offers a comfortable king-size bed, a sofa, a table with  chairs and a desk. a drawer and a closets. The bathroom and the kitchen are equipped with everything (cutlery, flatware, cooking utensils).
The quiet balcony has a back yard view that invites to just sit and relax.
The apartment provides household appliances such as fridge, microwave, toaster, coffee machine, kettel, vacum cleaner, washing machine, flatiron and ironing board.

Location
The apartment lies in a green quiet side road in the lively area of Wilmersdorf, on the border to Schöneberg, close the beautiful Viktoria-Luise-Platz and the famous Ku'damm. The area offers a large selection of bars, restaurants, cafés, shops and many night-life attractions. The world known KaDeWe (Department Store of the West) can be reached with a small walk.
There are two metro station nearby: Berliner Str (line U9 and U7) and Blisse Str (line U7). The U9 leads in 2 stops to the big station Zoologischer Garten, crossing of many lines, for example the central S-Bahn to Friedrichstrasse and Alexanderplatz. The Nollendorfplatz station is then only 2 stops away with the U3, or reachable on foot.

title: Charlottenstraße, Berlin
description:
The apartment is located in a quiet area of Berlin-Lankwitz. The neighborhood boasts a pleasant living atmosphere, green parks, good infrastructure with shopping facilities, and excellent public transport connections.


How is the commute from here to other locations?
The apartment at Charlottenstraße 50 in Berlin-Lankwitz offers excellent public transport connections.

The S-Bahn station Lankwitz (S25, S26) is only about 4–6 minutes walk away – perfect for fast connections towards the city centre, Südkreuz or Potsdam.
Several bus lines (among others 181, 187, 283, X83, M82) stop very close by and connect Lankwitz with Steglitz, Dahlem, Zehlendorf and many other parts of the city.
You need only about 20–30 minutes to get to central Berlin (e.g. Potsdamer Platz, Friedrichstraße or Alexanderplatz) with the S-Bahn – often even faster depending on the exact destination.

Ideal for commuters and everyone who wants to experience Berlin easily and comfortably.

Why Choose this apartment?
This apartment offers maximum convenience and comfort: fully equipped, move-in ready, and providing everything needed for easy, hassle-free living. Just move in and feel at home — no extra effort required.

Overview
This bright and fully furnished 2-room apartment with approx. 57 sqm of living space is located on Charlottenstraße in Berlin-Lankwitz and is ideal for singles or couples. The well-designed layout ensures excellent use of space.

The apartment is completely move-in ready — everything is provided. It features laminate flooring, tiled bathroom and kitchen, central heating, and a predominantly newly purchased interior. Highlights include blackout curtains, modern (partly dimmable) lighting, a 55-inch LG TV, Wi-Fi in all rooms (included in the rent), and a fully equipped kitchen with washing machine, dishwasher, and complete kitchenware.

Additional amenities include a walk-in storage room, a private basement unit of approx. 5 sqm, and ample storage space throughout the apartment.

The apartment is rented at an all-inclusive flat rent. The lease term is expected to be limited to 3 years, with the option to extend upon agreement and depending on individual needs.


Amenities & Furniture:
Cellar, Balcony, Utility room, Central Heating, Bathtub, Mirror, Washing machine, Box Spring Sofa, Double Bed, Bed sheets , Curtain rods, Blinds, Wardrobe, Blankets and pillows, Cutlery, Pans &  kitchen accessories, Fitted kitchen, Refrigerator, Microwave, Dishwasher, Toaster, Dining Table, TV, Shelf, Chairs

1) The contract can start on any date, and the rent will be calculated on a daily pro-rata basis.
2) Our contract charges are calculated on a daily pro-rata basis. This means your rent will be based only on the exact number of days from your move-in date.
3) Once the booking is confirmed and all documents are received, we  will send you a rental contract via email and You need to sign it & send it back to me within 48hours.
4) Registration possible and the necessary document will be provided post the move-in
5) The check in can only take place Monday to Friday 9 am until 6 pm. Check in on the weekends or national holidays would be possible upon request for a small fee of 100€
6) Liability insurance is required for your stay and that needs to be submitted to us within 15 days from your move in date.. We recommend you to search for one yourself with a keyword “Haftpflichtversicherung“
7) Final cleaning fee: 280 €
8) 7% Surcharge is applicable for short-lets (duration of less than 6 months)
9) For rental durations of more than six months, the deposit can be paid in three installments.
10) Seurity deposit amount needs to be paid before the move-in date

title: Willmanndamm, Berlin
description:
A cozy, fully furnished room in a central apartment in Berlin? – Here, you can have it all!

Your new apartment will be perfectly located, right next to the Ubahn station Kleistpark and in walking distance to the Park am Gleisdreieck.

But the new place doesn’t just offer a great location but will also be fully equipped and ready for you, to just move in. From a mixer to the washing machine, you will find everything you need.

To start your mornings right, we will provide you with Berlin’s very own “Double Eye” coffee in the newly equipped kitchen.

For a rather chill night in, you can relax in your bathtub with a glass of wine.

In your room you’ll find a freshly made bed, a small working space for you and your laptop, your own little lounge area and of course: free Wi-F. To top it all off, we even have a little extra: In your room there will be a stylish fixie rental bike waiting, which will accompany you while living in this great apartment.

In order to accept you as a tenant, I need the following documents: 

- Copy of ID, passport 
- Employment agreement (professionals) OR enrollment certificate (students)
- Liability insurance

Please notice that these are example pictures. The room will have the same features + a balcony. 
Feel free to contact me if you have further questions!

title: Grunewaldstraße, Berlin
description:
Es handelt sich um ein WG-Zimmer von ca. 23qm, in einer 5er WG. 
In diesem charmanten Zimmer werden Sie sich wie zu Hause fühlen. Mit viel natürlichem Licht, trendigen Möbeln und geräumigen Gemeinschaftsräumen, die Sie mit Ihren neuen Mitbewohnern genießen können, ist dieses Zimmer und Wohnung hübsch und praktisch.

Es gibt viele Bars, Café und Restaurants in der Umgebung sowie auch andere Geschäfte. Der nächste Supermarkt ist nicht weit entfernt und in der Nähe befinden sich U- und S-Bahn sowie Bus-Stationen.



This room has about 23sqm, in a shared flat of 5 people. 
You'll feel right at home in this charming room. With lots of natural light, trendy furniture and spacious common areas to enjoy with your new roommates, this room and apartment is pretty and practical.

There are many bars, cafe and restaurants in the area as well as other stores. The nearest supermarket is not far away and there are subway, commuter train and bus stations nearby.

title: Roennebergstraße, Berlin
description:
Das Altbau - Serviced Apartment mit Stuckdecke und enormer Deckenhöhe nahe der Schlossstrasse in Steglitz bietet alles was man braucht. Einfach Koffer auspacken und wohl fühlen.

Geboten wird ein großes Supersize - Bett zum Beine ausstrecken mit Bettwäsche und einer Auswahl an Kopfkissen, Schränke, ein Sideboard, eine große Kitchenette mit zwei Kochfeldern, einem Kühlschrank mit Gefrierfach, Gläser, Geschirr, Kochtöpfe und Pfannen. U9-Bahn-Halt „Walter-Schreiber-Platz“, S-Bahn-Stationen „Feuerbach und Friedenau “ in Laufweite. Beste Anbindung nach Schöneberg und zum Bahnhof Zoologischer Garten.

Direkt am Haus: Rheinstrasse/Schlossstrasse mit Forum und Boulevard als große Einkaufszentren.

Bäckerei/Apotheke/Rewe City und Restaurants nebenan.

title: Eisenacher Straße, Berlin
description:
Willkommen in Ihrem neuen Zuhause in der Eisenacher Straße, einem gemütlichen Rückzugsort im lebendigen Stadtteil Schöneberg! Dieses stilvoll möblierte Apartment bietet Ihnen modernen Wohnkomfort und eine hervorragende Lage in einem der charmantesten und vielseitigsten Viertel Berlins.

Das Apartment liegt in Schöneberg, einem Bezirk, der für seine bunte Mischung aus Kultur, Geschichte und urbanem Leben bekannt ist. Hier finden Sie das perfekte Gleichgewicht zwischen lebendiger Großstadtatmosphäre und entspanntem Wohnen.

Direkt vor Ihrer Haustür entdecken Sie eine Fülle von Restaurants, Cafés und Bars, die für jeden Geschmack etwas bieten. Genießen Sie internationale Küche, entspannen Sie bei einem Kaffee in einem der vielen gemütlichen Cafés oder lassen Sie den Tag in einer der charmanten Bars ausklingen. Besonders empfehlenswert ist der nahegelegene Winterfeldtplatz mit seinem beliebten Wochenmarkt, auf dem Sie frische und regionale Produkte sowie handgefertigte Spezialitäten finden.

Für Ihre täglichen Besorgungen bieten sich zahlreiche Einkaufsmöglichkeiten an. Von kleinen Boutiquen und Feinkostläden bis hin zu Supermärkten und Drogerien – alles ist bequem zu Fuß erreichbar. Der Nollendorfplatz, ein zentraler Knotenpunkt in Schöneberg, bietet zusätzlich eine Vielzahl an Geschäften und Dienstleistungen.

Natur- und Erholungssuchende werden die Nähe zum Volkspark Schöneberg-Wilmersdorf und zum Rudolph-Wilde-Park schätzen, die beide ideale Orte für Spaziergänge, Jogging oder Picknicks sind.

Die Verkehrsanbindung ist hervorragend. Die U-Bahn-Station Eisenacher Straße und der S-Bahnhof Julius-Leber-Brücke sind nur wenige Gehminuten entfernt und bieten Ihnen schnellen und bequemen Zugang zu allen Teilen Berlins. Ob Sie zur Arbeit pendeln oder die zahlreichen Sehenswürdigkeiten der Stadt erkunden möchten – von hier aus ist alles leicht erreichbar.

Das Apartment selbst ist eine wahre Wohlfühloase. Mit seiner modernen und geschmackvollen Einrichtung bietet es Ihnen ein behagliches Zuhause, in dem Sie sich sofort wohlfühlen werden. Die voll ausgestattete Küche lädt zum Kochen ein, und der helle Wohnbereich ist perfekt zum Entspannen und Verweilen. 

Erleben Sie das Beste von Berlin in Ihrem neuen möblierten Apartment in der Eisenacher Straße 54. Hier vereinen sich urbaner Lebensstil und komfortables Wohnen zu einem einzigartigen Wohnerlebnis, das keine Wünsche offenlässt

Englisch: 
Welcome to your new home on Eisenacher Straße, a cozy retreat in the vibrant district of Schöneberg! This stylishly furnished apartment offers modern living comfort and an excellent location in one of Berlin's most charming and diverse neighborhoods.

The apartment is located in Schöneberg, a district known for its colorful mix of culture, history, and urban life. Here, you'll find the perfect balance between a lively city atmosphere and relaxed living.

Right outside your door, you can discover a wealth of restaurants, cafes, and bars that offer something for every taste. Enjoy international cuisine, relax with a coffee in one of the many cozy cafes, or end your day in one of the charming bars. Highly recommended is the nearby Winterfeldtplatz with its popular weekly market, where you can find fresh and regional products as well as handcrafted specialties.

For your daily needs, there are numerous shopping options. From small boutiques and delicatessens to supermarkets and drugstores – everything is within easy walking distance. Nollendorfplatz, a central hub in Schöneberg, also offers a variety of shops and services.
Nature and relaxation seekers will appreciate the proximity to Volkspark Schöneberg-Wilmersdorf and Rudolph-Wilde-Park, both ideal spots for walks, jogging, or picnics.

The transportation links are excellent. The Eisenacher Straße U-Bahn station and the Julius-Leber-Brücke S-Bahn station are just a few minutes' walk away, offering quick and convenient access to all parts of Berlin. Whether you're commuting to work or exploring the city's many attractions, everything is easily reachable from here.

The apartment itself is a true haven of comfort. With its modern and tasteful furnishings, it offers a cozy home where you will feel immediately at ease. The fully equipped kitchen invites you to cook, and the bright living area is perfect for relaxing and unwinding.
Experience the best of Berlin from your new furnished apartment on Eisenacher Straße 54. Here, urban lifestyle and comfortable living combine to create a unique living experience that leaves nothing to be desired.

title: Kaiserallee, Berlin
description:
Relax at this peaceful place. Ideal for an individual, a couple or a family with kids. Location is a 15 mins direct train ride to some of Berlins most exciting places like Potsdamer Platz, Brandenburger Tor, and Friedrichstraße just to name a few and 10 mins to Südkreuz: Berlins main south railway station. The apartment is fully furnished and comes with a Washing Machine, Dishwasher, Fridge and toaster. 

Just 1 minute away is a special Turkish supermarket, 3 minutes away is a Russian supermarket and 5 minutes away is Edeka: a supermarket chain. 

The apartment comes with intensive cleaning by a professional cleaner twice a month at no extra charge so you don't need to worry about tidying up the apartment all the time. 

Note: Rent includes all utility charges.

title: Bahnhofstraße, Berlin
description:
Experience the vibrant heart of modern city life in Berlin Schöneberg Area Friedenau, in this elegant apartment with a generous living space of 67 square meters. Carefully designed, this apartment perfectly combines style and functionality. The apartment presents itself with a well-thought-out layout, consisting of two room: a welcoming hallway that gives a sense of harmony as soon as you enter, and a spacious bedroom and very charming livingroom.  A special highlight is the new kitchen, equipped with a fully functional kitchen and a modern bathroom with shower an bathtub. Enjoy the luxury of a brand new box spring bed. A spacious wardrobe and high-definition 4K TV will meet all your needs, whether it's productivity or relaxation. 

Erleben Sie das pulsierende Herz des modernen Stadtlebens im Berliner Stadtteil Schöneberg Friedenau in dieser eleganten Wohnung mit einer großzügigen Wohnfläche von 67 Quadratmetern. Diese sorgfältig gestaltete Wohnung verbindet Stil und Funktionalität perfekt. Die Wohnung präsentiert sich mit einem durchdachten Grundriss, bestehend aus zwei Räumen: einem einladenden Flur, der schon beim Betreten ein Gefühl von Harmonie vermittelt, einem geräumigen Schlafzimmer und einem sehr charmanten Wohnzimmer. Ein besonderes Highlight ist die neue Küche, ausgestattet mit einer voll funktionsfähigen Einbauküche und einem modernen Badezimmer mit Dusche und Badewanne. Genießen Sie den Luxus eines brandneuen Boxspringbetts. Ein geräumiger Kleiderschrank und ein hochauflösender 4K-Fernseher erfüllen alle Ihre Bedürfnisse, egal ob Produktivität oder Entspannung.

title: Feurigstraße, Berlin
description:
Apartment Listing – 1-Bedroom and 1 Livingroom Altbau Apartment with Balcony in Berlin-Schöneberg
This charming  Altbau apartment is located on the first floor of a well-maintained building in a quiet side street in the heart of Berlin-Schöneberg. It features beautiful period details such as high ceilings, wooden floorboards, and ornate stucco.

The fully furnished apartment (approx. 60 m2) includes:

Living room with a comfortable sofa, dining table, and TV

Bedroom with a 160 cm wide box spring bed and wardrobe

Fitted kitchen with refrigerator, washing machine, and essential kitchenware

Modern bathroom with a bathtub

Balcony – perfect for relaxing

Enjoy peace and quiet while being centrally located – shops, cafés, restaurants, and public transport are all within walking distance.

Perfect for singles or couples who appreciate the charm of a classic Berlin Altbau apartment in a prime location.

Wohnungsanzeige – 2-Zimmer-Altbauwohnung mit Balkon in Berlin-Schöneberg
In einer ruhigen Seitenstraße im Herzen von Berlin-Schöneberg liegt diese charmante 2-Zimmer-Altbauwohnung im 1. Obergeschoss eines gepflegten Mehrfamilienhauses. Die Wohnung überzeugt durch klassische Altbaudetails wie hohe Decken, Dielenböden und aufwendig gearbeiteten Stuck.

Die ca. 60 m2 große Wohnung ist vollständig möbliert und bietet:

Wohnzimmer mit gemütlichem Sofa, Esstisch und TV

Schlafzimmer mit einem komfortablen 160 cm breiten Boxspringbett und Kleiderschrank

Einbauküche mit Kühlschrank, Waschmaschine und allen wichtigen Küchenutensilien

Modernes Badezimmer mit Badewanne

Balkon – ideal zum Entspannen

Dank der Lage in einer ruhigen Seitenstraße wohnen Sie ruhig, aber dennoch zentral – Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, Cafés, Restaurants und öffentliche Verkehrsmittel sind fußläufig erreichbar.

Ideal für Singles oder Paare, die das Berliner Altbauflair in einer top Lage genießen möchten.

title: Cheruskerstraße, Berlin
description:
This charming 2-room apartment is located on the 2nd floor of a well-maintained front building and combines classic old-building charm with modern comfort. Fully furnished and beautifully decorated in a cozy Boho style, it’s the perfect home for anyone looking for character and comfort in the heart of Berlin.

Features:

Bright living room with extendable sofa bed

Bedroom with comfortable box-spring bed (160 × 200 cm)

Balcony facing the street

Fully equipped kitchen

Modern bathroom

Elegant wooden floors

Tastefully furnished in Boho style

Situated in a quiet and charming side street in Schöneberg, close to Cheruskerpark and S-Bahn Schöneberg. Cafés, restaurants, markets, and shops are all within walking distance

title: Bregenzer Straße, Berlin
description: Schön renoviertes Appartement liegt in einer ruhigen Seitenstraße, sehr zentral in Berlin Wilmersdorf, nahe Olivaer Platz und Kurfürstendamm, einer Gegend mit zahlreichen Restaurants und attraktiven Geschäften. Unser Schrank, die Kommode und die Garderobe im Flur bieten Platz für all Ihre Sachen.

title: Gotenstraße, Berlin
description:
Herzlichen willkommen in einer 100m2 großen Altbauperle mitten auf der typischen Schöneberger Roten Insel. Wir haben aus einer alten Ladeneinheit ein offenes, lichtdurchflutetes Apartment gezaubert, in dem Sie sich rundum wohlfühlen können. Wollen Sie wissen, was Berliner lieben? Hohe Decken (3,40m), Stuck, alter abgeschliffener Dielenboden, Flügeltüren...hier finden Sie es! Gleichzeitig haben wir die Räume rundum saniert und auf den höchsten Standard gebracht. Von der geräumigen Diele treten Sie in die offene Wohnküche mit integriertem Esszimmer, sie bildet den Mittelpunkt der Wohnung. Über eine altehrwürdige Flügeltür gelangt man in ein großes Wohnzimmer, eine Treppe führt von der Küche aus zum Untergeschoß, in dem sich Waschmaschine, Trockner und ein zweites kernsaniertes Badezimmer verstecken. Von der Diele aus zweigen zwei Schlafzimmer mit Kingsize Boxspringbetten bzw. Einzel-Boxspringbetten ab, Kinder werden sich über das vorhandene Etagenbett freuen. Zwischen beiden Zimmern befindet sich das neue, hochwertige Duschbad. Das Apartment verfügt zudem über zwei Schlafsofas, um Schlafmöglichkeiten für bis zu maximal 7 Personen zu bieten.

title: Gutzkowstraße, Berlin
description:
WHO WE ARE:
We are a start-up committed to solely hosting ambitious successful young professionals aged 21-35. We believe that hosting like-minded go-getters is essential for a pleasant flat atmosphere. With your relocation to Berlin to one of our luxurious co-living spaces, you will get direct access to an elite community of carefully selected individuals. You will instantly be integrated in Berlin’s social circle of bright rainmakers.

Renting a room with us can be compared to joining a selective membership club. Ultimately, our mission is to provide aspiring personalities like you, who are newly drawn to Berlin, with prompt communal cohesion and moreover with an extensive network of thriving achievers. Not just within your own co-living space, but also beyond your flat. On a periodical basis, we organize events, where tenants from different co-living spaces come together to enjoy an exciting evening and are moreover given a platform to network and bond. These events can be in form of fancy restaurant dinners, exclusive catered house-parties, long weekend lunches or even personalized pub crawls. Of course, with pleasure, we carry all costs of our highly valued get-togethers.

Regarding living comfort, we have established a new level of luxury in the co-living space segment. All our flats are equipped with the finest furniture highlighted by kingsized box-spring beds, modern fully fitted kitchens as well as all necessary appliances and utensils one might need in an apartment. Every flat of ours has been individually furnished with an eye for warmth and detail. Furthermore, we only choose prime locations for our apartments. Our shared flats can primarily be found in Berlin's most fancy and central residential area: Westend.

With us, the rent you pay is an all-inclusive rent. No headaches, no subsequent payments or hidden costs. Everything is included: electricity, very fast 100 Mbit/s internet, water, heating and washing machine costs. title: Laubacher Straße, Berlin
description: Das Apartment in Berlin Schöneberg-Friedenau befindet sich in einer ruhigen Wohnanlage mit guter Verkehrsanbindung von Bus und U-Bahn. Die möblierte Wohnung verfügt über 1 Zimmer und bietet Ihnen den Raum, sich fern von Zuhause heimisch zu fühlen. Auch für Gastdozenten und Studenten ist das möblierte Wohnen in Schöneberg zu empfehlen, da der FU-Campus sich ganz in der Nähe der möblierten Unterkunft befindet. Ausstattung Die Wohnung verfügt über einen Wohnbereich mit eigener Küche, einem kleinen Flur, einem separaten Badezimmer und einem Schlafzimmer sowie einem gemeinschaftlichen Waschraum mit Trockner. Im Wohnzimmer befinden sich ein Sofa und im Schlafzimmer sind zwei Einzelbetten vorhanden. Des Weiteren stehen zwei Kommoden, zwei Kleiderschränke und ein Arbeitstisch mit zwei Stühlen zur Verfügung. Die voll ausgestattete und gut eingerichtete Einbauküche bietet einen Kochherd mit Backofen und mehrere Einbauschränke, einen Kühlschrank mit Tiefkühlfach und eine Spüle. Eine Kaffeemaschine, einen Toaster und einen Wasserkocher können gegen eine Kaution von 20€ pro Gerät ausgeliehen werden. Zum Essen und Verweilen steht ein Esstisch mit zwei Stühlen zur Verfügung. Im Flur befinden sich ein Schuhschrank, Abstellschrank und Wandspiegel. Das Badezimmer mit Badezimmer bietet verschiedene Ablagemöglichkeiten für persönliche Utensilien. Die Kosten für Internet betragen monatlich 20,00€. Lage Unsere möblierte Wilmersdorfer Wohnung liegt an der Grenze zu Schöneberg-Friedenau und Steglitz. Auf der Straße stehen öffentliche Parkplätze zur Verfügung. Mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln kommen Sie von dem Berliner Apartment schnell zu jedem Ziel. Der U-Bahnhof Walther-Schreiber Platz ist in 5 Minuten zu erreichen. Ebenfalls in ca. 5 Minuten Fußweg von der Wohnung erreichen Sie bequem diverse Supermärkte, Bäcker, Post, Cafe, Restaurant, Ärzte und Apotheken. In näherer Umgebung sind das Schloss-Strassen-Center, Forum Steglitz, Boulevard Berlin erreichbar, "das Schloss" ist zu Fuß ebenfalls nur 5 bis 10 Minuten entfernt. Die Anmeldegebühr beträgt in der Woche Mo-Fr von 10-17 Uhr 65€ pro Person und außerhalb der Öffnungszeiten (Mo-Fr 10-17 Uhr) oder am Wochenende 100€ pro Person.

title: Yorckstraße, Berlin
description:
Modern, Cozy and Central apartment, recently renovated and full-equipped with all the comforts you need in a top location in the heart of Berlin. The apartment has a minimalistic and modern interior design in a beautiful architectural historic building. The apartment has a stylish division in the main room that creates two different spaces. Perfect to relax after your work or trips around the city, or for those ones willing to have a calm environment to work peacefully and rest.

In the sleeping area you have a big and comfortable bed and a spacious closet to organize all your things. You also have an office desk with a lamp and a leather chair for eventual work. In the living space you have a comfortable Bed-Sofa with a stylish carpet and TV with Netflix included. There is also a modern white table with 4 comfortable chairs. The kitchen is completely new and full-equipped. The new washing machine is located in the kitchen. The bathroom has a modern walk-in shower with a shower-panel that has a massage function. The apartment counts with a modern LED lighting system and with smart lights in the living and sleeping area that can be controlled to have cold or warm light and/or different intensities. In the apartment there is a Smart-IP Camera (optional for our guests). The ceiling of the living room has a beautiful and original ornament that is over 100 years old and still well-maintained, with no-doubts a beautiful piece of history. 

The apartment is located in a charming neighborhood in the top district of Kreuzberg with lots of green spaces in the surroundings. You are just a walking distance away from the beautiful parks “Gleisdreieck” and “Viktoriapark”. The most famous street-food for currywurst and Kebap in Berlin are just in the corner (Curry 36 and Mustafa ́s Gemüse Kebap). The Berliners well-known “York Cinema” is just next door. The famous sightseeing of “Checkpoint Charlie” and also the Berlin Wall & the Museum „Thopographie des Terrors“ is just 2 stops away with the metro. You can also walk to these famous sights that are just 2km away. From there you can also reach in walking distance “Potsdamer Platz” where you can find the new Mall of Berlin and also the famous building of Sony-Center. There you can find a cinema, cafés and restaurants. Not far from “Potsdamer Platz” you can find the famous “Brandenburg Gates” and “Holocaust Memorial”. The apartment is very central and is well connected to the public transportation.

title: Schönburgstraße, Berlin
description:
Description
This bright and spacious 130m2 loft-style penthouse apartment offers majestic views over the canopy of a small park, giving the feeling of a truly idyllic retreat in the countryside but is in fact in the middle of the city - less than 20 minutes to the Friedrichstrasse. The apartment is located in Alt-Tempelhof, close to Kreuzberg, the multicultural melting pot and currently the most interesting part of Berlin with its vivid art scene, English theater, bars and restaurants.
 
The living room is very bright, has high ceilings and measures about 70 square meters. It is divided into three separate areas:  a large dining area with a beautiful wooden dining-table and an attractive sunny balcony, a generous sitting area with an L-shaped sofa and in the front next to the kitchen a cozy fireplace with a wood-burning stove. A large skylight lets in even more light: a crackling fire in winter and above you twinkling stars - what more could you want?
 
The open-plan kitchen has a  "breakfast bar", a very good stove, large fridge and a dishwasher. A large larder provides space for essentials such as a freezer, provisions, wood for the oven and other things.
The apartment has two large separate bedrooms. which face east and, like the terrace, receive the morning sunshine. The master bedroom has a large king size bed and a desk. The second bedroom a smaller double bed and built-in storage cupboards. All rooms have central heating.
 
On entering through the front door, you will find beautiful stone tiles in the hall and bathroom. The bathroom, which is also light and sunny, comes with a floor to ceiling shower and is equipped with a high quality new washing machine.
 
Next to the bedroom is a large store room, which is suitable for clothes, shoes and other things like vacuum cleaner, etc. 
 
Behind the house there is a courtyard with communal garden, lawn and children’s play area.
 
The street is quiet, tree-lined and cobble-stoned and has a number of architecturally beautiful buildings. The park in front of the apartment is a small paradise with ponds, walkways and ancient trees and children's play area. There is an open Qigong Group practising meditative movements in the park twice a week in the morning. There is even a local church at the edge of the park.
 
The former Tempelhof Airport, which is now a huge green area and the creative playground for many Berliners, can be reached on foot within 10 minutes. Here more and more people pursue recreational activities, have fun with urban gardening and come together for barbecues.
 
Two Underground stops will take you to the UFA-Fabrik, a cultural oasis with performance art, concerts and entertainment.
 
The famous ‘Bergmannkiez’ (the fashionable area of Kreuzberg) is a mere 10-15 minutes trip by Underground on the U6 or by bicycle.
 
The S-Bahn Südkreuz, which is also one of the main railways terminals, is three bus stops away. There is easy access to both Berlin Tegel and Berlin Schoenefeld airports.
 
In the immediate location of the apartment you will find numerous shopping possibilities, from local supermarket to discounters; a large department store is directly opposite the park. In the Schönburgstraße itself there is a high quality local cafe.
 
The apartment offers the perfect location for people who want lots of space, a terrace with great views and room to move and breathe.
 
And last but not least: the apartment comes with a built-in fitness facility. Being an historical building there is no elevator and so you will need to climb four flights of stairs to enjoy all the above benefits. But it is worth it.

title: Lietzenburger Straße, Berlin
description:
The Lofty-Room
Spacious 35sqm provide enough space to feel more than comfortable. A lofty style room with plenty of natural light. The box spring measures 180cm and the couch is incredibly cozy. In the evening, the couch lamp sets the cozy atmosphere to its peak. The workspace is oriented towards the outside with a high-quality desk. For your clothes, there's a clothes rack in an industrial style next to the dresser.

The Apartment
110sqm, freshly renovated, charming and upscale. It is this kind of flat where you feel home at the first place.The modern bathroom comes with a bathtub, ample space and a window for some natural light. The fully equipped kitchen offers plenty of storage space and a charming French balcony for a bright ambiance. Perfect for preparing your favorite meals! And for the clean up afterwards, there's of course a dishwasher. Additionally, a washing machine is available in the utility room.

The Location
Grab your subway map and let's go! The subway is only 2 minutes far by foot, which takles you to the bustling Kottbusser Tor and the trendy Warschauer Straße in no time. Attention students! The Technical University (TU) is just a short 15-minute bike ride away. No more long commutes. Right outside your doorstep, you'll find endless shopping options that leave nothing to be desired. From everyday needs to special treasures - everything within reach! A variety of restaurants, bars, and clubs await you, offering something for every taste. From rustic to upscale, from historical to modern - there's something for everyone here. From historical sites to magnificent churches, well-kept parks, famous theaters, the Wilmersdorf-Charlottenburg district has plenty to offer.

______________________

Das Loft-Zimmer
Großzügige 35qm bieten genug Platz zum Wohlfühlen. Ein Zimmer, das mit viel natürlichem Licht punktet. Das Boxspringbett kommt auf 180cm und die Couch ist unglaublich gemütlich. Abends bringt die Couch-Lampe die wohlige Stimmung auf den Höhepunkt. Der Arbeitsbereich ist mit Blick nach draußen ausgerichtet und mit einem hochwertigem Schreibtisch ausgestattet. Für deine Klamotten gibt es neben der Kommode eine Kleiderstange im Industrial-Stil.

Die Wohnung
110qm, frisch renoviert und gehoben. Man kommt an und fühlt sich absolut zu Hause. Das moderne Bad hat eine Badewanne und genug Raum. Ein Gäste-WC steht auch zur Verfügung. Durch das Fenster ist für Tageslicht gesorgt. Die voll ausgestattete Küche bietet nicht nur viel Stauraum, sondern auch einen charmanten französischen Balkon, der zu einem hellen und luftigem Ambiente beiträgt. Perfekt für die Zubereitung deiner Lieblingsmahlzeiten! Und für den Abwasch gibt es eine Spülmaschine. Sonst steht in der Abstellkammer eine Waschmaschine zur Verfügung.

Die Lage
Schnapp dir deine U-Bahn-Karte und los geht's! Nur 2 Gehminuten entfernt befindet sich die U-Bahn-Station, die dich im Handumdrehen zum pulsierenden Kottbusser Tor bis hin zur angesagten Warschauer Straße bringt. Studenten aufgepasst! Die Technische Universität (TU) ist nur einen kurzen 15-minütigen Fahrradweg entfernt. Kein langes Pendeln mehr. Direkt vor der Haustür findest du neben dem KaDeWe eine Fülle von Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, die keine Wünsche offen lassen. Vom täglichen Bedarf bis hin zu besonderen Schätzen - alles in Reichweite! In unmittelbarer Nähe erwarten dich eine Vielzahl von Restaurants, Bars und Clubs, die für jeden Geschmack etwas bieten. Von urig bis hin zu gehoben, von historisch bis modern - hier ist für jeden etwas dabei. Prunkvollen Gotteshäuser, gepflegte Parks, berühmte Theater. Der Stadtteil Wilmersdorf-Charlottenburg hat viel zu bieten.

description:
Designer Apartment, 1 Zimmer mit großem Südbalkon. Fußboden Wallnussparkett. Bad mit XXL Dusche (140cm), Regendusche und Fußbodenheizung. Oberste Etage (4.OG) mit Aufzug, großer Balkon mit Markise und Teakholz Möbeln und Blick ins Grüne (Bäume). Ruhig gelegen mit Parkplätzen vor dem Hau, alternativ auch nur 3-5 Minuten Fußweg zur U-Bahn oder zum Bus. Die größte Berliner Einkaufsstraße ( Schloßstraße) ist nur 500m entfernt, zum Kurfürstendamm (City West) sind es nur 5 min. Fahrt mit der U-Bahn und zum Potsdamer Platz/Brandenburger Tor nur 11 min. Fahrt mit der S-Bahn. Der nächste Waschsalon ist nur 200m entfernt. 
Die Wohnung wurde gerade noch frisch renoviert und eingerichtet, daher sind noch einige Details auf den Fotos nicht ganz fertig. Die Studio verfügt auch über Vorhänge und die Toilette hat einen neuen Sitz/Deckel.

title: Zähringerstraße, Berlin
description:
The 1-room flat offered here is located in a central residential are(hidden)erlin-Wilmersdorf. The entire complex, which was built in the late 1950s, is in good condition.

The flat is located on the 5th floor, which can be reached via a lift. From the central staircase you reach the flat via an arcade. The flat has a cleverly designed and well-thought-out floor plan. In total, approx. 42 m2 are distributed over a hallway, a large living room, an interior bathroom with tub, a storage room and a small kitchen separated from the living room. Due to the south orientation of the complex and a large window front, plenty of sunlight enters the flat. On hot sunny days, an outdoor awning provides a good indoor climate.

The flat is completely furnished as new.  Furthermore, it has:
- Wifi
- cable TV
- washing machine
- coffee maker
- All utilities are included

This city flat is located in the heart of Wilmersdorf, a district known for its diverse culinary offerings and charming shops. Be it delicacies from maître philippe or a relaxing breakfast in Berlin's perhaps most beautiful open-air café, the Weyers - everything is on offer here. In the evening, many stylish bars tempt you to go out and meet friends. Berlin's most famous shopping mile, Kurfürstendamm, is only a few hundred metres away. Gucci, Chanel, Louis Vuitton and Hermès are just some of the many shops that give Ku'damm a very special flair.

title: Fürbringerstraße, Berlin
description:
This cosy Altbau flat is located in the heart of residential Kreuzberg, between the famous Bergmankiez and Gräfekiez. The very central location offers transport links with 3 metros and several bus lines as well as park and water access in immediate walking distance.

The flat features 2 double bedrooms, a huge common area with open kitchen, dining room and TV area. With its 4 meter high ceilings, newly refurnished and decorated in a cosy industrial design the flat is a masterpiece in Kreuzberg.

The loft-like combination of a large open kitchen, dining room and TV area (60sqm) invites you to enjoy the cosy and charming atmosphere. Additionally, the flat features 2 double bedrooms (plus sleeping sofa in the living room) and a spacious bathroom. Especially the open kitchen is ideal for cooking in small groups and enjoying dinner afterwards in the living room before you finish the evening with an aperitif in the couch area.

As already described 3 metros are in close walking distance (2-8min), meaning basically everywhere in Berlin is reached within 30 minutes. Also in the immediate vicinity are Viktoria Park, Tempelhof Field (old airport), Hasenheide Park, Landwehr Canal, etc. A superbe location that we enjoy more and more each day! There is free parking in the streets around the flat.
