title: Cicerostraße, Berlin
description:
Ich möchte meine gut geschnittene 80 qm große 3-Zimmer-Wohnung vorübergehend vermieten. Sie befindet sich im Westen Berlins in einer ruhigen Seitenstraße des Kurfürstendamms und ist für den besonderen Vermietungsbedarf aufgrund eines vorübergehenden Arbeitseinsatzes fernab des Wohnortes bestimmt. 
Die unmittelbare Nähe zum Kurfürstendamm bietet zahlreiche Einkaufs- und Freizeitmöglichkeiten von Supermärkten über Fitnesscenter bis hin zur weltbekannten Schaubühne in direkter Nachbarschaft. 
Das Gebäude ist Teil eines prachtvollen Ensembles aus den 20er Jahren, das nach Plänen des berühmten Architekten Erich Mendelsohn erbaut wurde. Das auffälligste Merkmal sind die wellenförmigen Loggien, die einen schönen Anblick bieten und sofort ein angenehmes Wohngefühl vermitteln. Die Doppelkastenfenster sind mit energieeffizientem Glas ausgestattet. In allen Räumen außer Küche und Bad wurde neuer Parkettboden verlegt. Die Ausstattung bietet mit einer Raumhöhe von 3,10 m und einer praktischen Loggia Altbaucharme und hohem Wohnkomfort. Die Wohnung befindet sich im 2. Obergeschoss mit Aufzug, 
In nur einer Gehminute von der Wohnung fahren zwei Buslinien, die Sie nach maximal fünf Minuten Wartezeit an Ihr Ziel bringen. Der S-Bahnhof Halensee ist nur zehn Gehminuten (oder 2 Busstationen) entfernt. Durch die Anbindung an die Ringbahn sind Sie ohne Umsteigen schnell mit fast allen Bezirken der Stadt verbunden. Der ebenfalls 10 Gehminuten entfernte S-Bahnhof Charlottenburg bietet weitere schnelle und bequeme Möglichkeiten in die Zentren Berlins zu gelangen. 
Den U-Bahnhof Adenauer Platz erreichen Sie nach fünf Minuten (oder einer Busstation). Dort bringt Sie die zentrale U- Bahnlinie 7 in den Norden der Stadt oder in die andere Richtung zum Flughafen. 
OBJEKTBESCHREIBUNG 
Vom Flur mit Garderobe, Schuhregal und kleinem Schrank gelangt man in alle Räume. Die Küche verfügt über eine voll ausgestattete Einbauküche inkl. Marken-Einbaugeräten und einem kleinen runden Tisch für drei Personen mit Stühlen. 
Das Schlafzimmer mit ruhiger Lage zum Innenhof bietet ausreichend Stauraum durch einen sehr großen Einbauschrank. Ein Doppelbett hat die Maße 150x200 cm. Das Badezimmer ist mit einer Badewanne, einem Corian-Waschtisch und einer Marken-Waschmaschine ausgestattet. 
Das Wohnzimmer - mit TV und Teppich - bietet mit einer De Sede Ledercouch und einem Softline Sofa/Schlafsofa ausreichend Sitzmöglichkeiten und weitere Schlafmöglichkeiten.. Die Kastenfenster sind mit Jalousien und Vorhängen ausgestattet. 
Vom Wohnzimmer gelangen Sie auch direkt zum angrenzenden Esszimmer, das mit einem großen Esstisch und einem kleinen Schreibtisch ausgestattet ist. Von hier aus erreicht man die gemütliche Loggia mit Tisch, Bank und Stühlen. 
Für die Reservierung sind folgende Dokumente erforderlich: 
• Identitätsnachweis durch amtlich ausgestellten Personalausweis oder Reisepass • Arbeitsvertrag • Lohnzettel oder Kontoauszug 
WICHTIG: Bitte beachten Sie, dass die Anzahlung und die Kaution sofort nach Vertragsunterzeichnung fällig sind. Damit Sie pünktlich einziehen können, müssen die Beträge VOR dem Einzugstermin auf meinem Konto eingegangen sein. Eine Überweisungsbestätigung reicht nicht aus. 
Bitte beachten Sie, dass HousingAnywhere eine Online-Buchungsplattform ist. Es ist daher nicht möglich, Kontaktdaten auszutauschen oder Besichtigungen anzubieten. Wenn Sie diese Unterkunft buchen möchten, senden Sie mir bitte eine Buchungsanfrage oder eine Nachricht und geben Sie bitte Ihr Alter und Ihren Beruf an. Ich freue mich darauf, Sie kennenzulernen. 
Diese Wohnung ist ideal für ein Paar mit einem kleinen Kind. Sie ist buchbar für mindestens 3 Monate.

title: Kolonnenstraße, Berlin
description:
This beautiful and exquisitely equipped apartment is situated in Schöneberg. The pictures say more than words. S1, U7 and many buses leave here. Feel welcome in this vibrant part of Berlin with restaurants, bars and shops in walking distance.

The apartment is equipped with everything you need for your daily life, so just grab your suitcase and move in! The landlady ist always availabe for questions or in case something is missing, since she lives in the same building.

It is also possible to use the living room as a second bedroom and in this case the middle room as the living room. Monthly payment will then be € 3.000,--.

The apartment will be free from (hidden).


Diese Traumwohnung liegt im Herzen von Berlin-Schöneberg - ein Kiez, der Kultur, Restaurants, Cafés und Shoppingmöglichkeiten bietet. Einrichtung und Ausstattung sind hochwertig und  mit viel Liebe zum Detail ausgewählt. Alles, was man für einen unkomplizierten Alltag benötigt, ist vorhanden: Handtücher, Putzutensilien, Kochutensilien, Geschirr, Gläser, Staubsauger, Kaffeemaschine, Waschmaschine, Smart-TV, W-LAN, etc. etc. - so dass Sie einfach mit ihrem Koffer einziehen und Ihren Alltag in Berlin starten können! Sollte etwas fehlen, ist die Vermieterin als Ansprechpartnerin verfügbar, da sie im selben Haus wohnt.

Die Wohnung ist perfekt an den ÖPNV angebunden:  S- und U-Bahn und viele Busse fahren unmittelbar vor der Haustür bzw. in kurzer Laufdistanz ab. Restaurants, Cafès und Geschäfte in Laufnähe.

Die Wohnung ist momentan für die Nutzung durch 2 Personen angelegt, kann aber auch durch 4 Personen genutzt werden, dadurch erhöht sich die Warmmiete auf € 3.000,--.

title: Finckensteinallee, Berlin
description:
Hey, and welcome to our apartment in Berlin-Dahlem! :-)

This is a simple, clean, and recently renovated flat in a quiet part of Berlin. It’s in Dahlem, a calm and green neighborhood that’s still well connected to the city.

The apartment has one bedroom with a double bed and a single bed (which you can also turn into another double if needed). In the living room, there’s a sofa that can be pulled out into a bed too — so up to six people can sleep here if needed, though it’s most comfortable for four.

There’s a small open kitchen with the basics you’ll need to cook, plus a dining table. The living room has a TV and gets plenty of natural light.

The bathroom has been redone too, with a proper shower, a mirror, and a washing machine.

Shops, bakeries, and cafés are within walking distance, and you’re also close to Grunewald if you want some nature. Buses are 2 minutes away (Karwendelstraße or Bundesarchiv), and the S-Bahn (Lichterfelde West/Ost) isn’t far either.

title: Kulmbacher Straße, Berlin
description:
Beautiful, cozy apartment in Berlin, Schönberg, just a 3-minute walk from KaDeWe and Kurfürstendamm. This means that the apartment is close to many nice cafes and restaurants, some of which serve very good international cuisine. In this hotspot location, all kinds of shops are of course nearby. This also includes many well-known chain stores such as Peek and Cloppenburg. 

Fortunately, the apartment is in a beautiful building in a quieter area, so you don't have to worry about the noise of the high streets. Public transport is of course very close to the apartment and supermarkets are just around the corner. 

According to a recent analysis by HousingAnywhere, the apartment is below average in price, but is in a far above-average location in Berlin. 

The apartment has a bed and a sofa that can be converted into a double bed. The living room leads to a beautiful private balcony where you can work or eat while looking out onto the quiet alley. Unlike most apartments in Berlin, the kitchen is in its own room with plenty of seating. This allows couples to cook/sit in peace without disturbing the other person.

title: Ermanstraße, Berlin
description:
The apartment is in a quiet residential area and is constantly being renovated. At a good 18 square meters, it is ideal for one person with the 140 cm bed, a second person could visit on the comfortable armchair bed with topper, i. H. not suitable for permanent use. For an additional person then further costs arise on request.

Das Appartement liegt in einem ruhigen Wohngebiet und wird laufend renoviert. Auf gut 18 Quadratmetern ist es für eine Person mit dem 140er Bett ideal, eine zweite Person könnte auf dem komfortablen Schlafsessel mit Topper zu Besuch, d. h. nicht zur dauerhaften Nutzung geeignet, kommen.

title: Eisackstraße, Berlin
description:
Fully equipped 3-room apartment, 72 square meters, with a balcony in Schöneberg near Firdenau. The space consists of a large bedroom, a large living room, an additional room suitable for an child's room or an office, a large, fully equipped kitchen, a bathroom, and a balcony.  A storage unit (Keller) and access to a communal garden with grassy areas, trees, a tennis table, and a children's playground are also included. Situated on the 2nd floor, the apartment has friendly neighbors. Commuting is straightforward with both S-Bahn (Ring-Bahn) and U-Bahn stations nearby. The neighborhood offers a variety of restaurants, coffee shops, bars, and shopping centers.

The apartment is equipped with:
Living room - 55-inch smart TV (Samsung), dining table and chairs, coffee table, sofa + armchair, carpet, decorative storage unit, shelves, standing lamp, stool unit that opens into a single bed.

Bedroom - 180x200 (king size) bed, nightstands, drawer unit, 2 closets, table lamps, full body mirror

Office - Desk, fan.

Hall - Coat hanger,  hallway cabinet, fire extinguisher

Kitchen - Stand-alone fridge/freezer, oven, microwave, induction stove, dishwasher, toaster, espresso machine, kettle, dishes, pots and pans,  exhaust hood, washing machine, extra-large sink, drying rack. vacuum cleaner.

Balcony - Foldable table, chairs, seating unit with storage.

Storage unit

title: Münchener Straße, Berlin
description:
Vollausgestattetes Apartment im Hochpaterre eines Berliner Altbaus in der Nähe des Viktoria-Luise-Platzes im Bayerischen Viertel, 10 Minuten Fußweg zum Ku ́Damm. Mit großer Liebe zum Detail wohnen Sie in einer komplett umgebauten Wohnung  auf 38qm.

In der Ausführung wurde besonderer Wert auf die Verwendung ökologischer Materialien sowie Nachhaltigkeit gelegt. Ein massgeschneiderte Küche sowie Designmöbel von Vitra und USM runden das Wohngefühl ab.
Ursprüngliches Fischgratparkett sowie Dielen liegen in Küche, Flur und Schlafzimmer. Das Bad ist mit Naturstein augestattet. Grosse Fensterfronten mit Rolläden und Vorhängen sorgen  für ein helles Raumerlebnis.

Das Apartment mit einer Raumhöhe von 3,40 m bietet Ihnen anspruchsvolle Einbauten mit viel Stauraum und mit einer sehr hochwertigen Ausstattung für Kochen, Schlafen, Entspannen und Arbeiten. Badezimmereinrichtung, Möbel, Beleuchtung und Accessoires sind sorgfältig ausgesucht. Die Küche bietet Ihnen ein Cerankochfeld, Spülmaschine, Kühlschrank und einen Backofen  von Miele. Sie schlafen auf einem 140 cm breiten biologischen Lattenrost, einer Naturlatex Matratze in biologischen Baumwollbettbezügen. 

Sie erwartet ein Entertain TV, VDSL Internet und W LAN. Küchengeräte, Wasserkocher, Toaster, Waschmaschine (Miele), Bügeleisen und vieles mehr sind inklusive. Der Mietpreis versteht sich inklusive aller Nebenkosten und inklusive einer 2 wöchentlichen  Reinigung. Die Endreinigung wird zusätzlich in Rechnung gestellt.

Das Apartment befindet sich in einem lebendigen, nicht touristischen, gemischten Wohngebiet zwischen dem Prager-, dem Bayerischen- und dem Viktoria-Luise-Platz. Als Vermieter wohnen wir mit unserer Familie in dem gleichen Gebäude im 1.OG und sind schnell ansprechbar.

Der Viktoria-Luise-Platz in Schöneberg zählt zu den schönsten Plätzen Berlins. In unmittelbarer Umgebung befinden sich zahlreiche sehr gute Restaurants. Der Bayerische Platz bietet sehr gute Einkaufsmöglichkeiten von Drogerien bis hin zu Bio-Supermärkten, ein großes Fittnessstudio und zahlreiche weitere Geschäfte und Cafés. Fußläufig erreichen Sie das KadeWe, den Kurfürstendamm und die City West. Der bekannte Winterfeldplatz mit vielen kleinen Geschäften und dem ganzjährigen Wochenmarkt am Mittwoch und Samstag befindet sich nur 1 Kilometer entfernt. 

Das Apartment liegt an der U Bahnlinie 4 mit Anbindung an die U Bahnlinien U1, U2 und U3 (Nollendorfplatz) sowie die U 7 am Bayerischen Platz. Die S Bahnlinien erreichen Sie über die U 4 am Innsbrucker Platz. Stellplätze sind in der Regel im Strassenraum vorhanden. Der Bahnhof Südkreuz, die Stadtautobahn und der Flughafen Tegel sind von Schöneberg sehr gut erreichbar.

The Neighbourhood

The apartment is located in a lively, non-touristy, mixed residential area between Pragerplatz, Bayerischenplatz and Viktoria-Luise-Platz. As landlords, we live with our family in the same building on the 1st floor and can be contacted quickly.

Viktoria-Luise-Platz in Schöneberg is one of the most beautiful squares in Berlin. There are numerous very good restaurants in the immediate vicinity. Bayerischer Platz offers very good shopping opportunities from drugstores to organic supermarkets, a large fitness studio and numerous other shops and cafés. Within walking distance you can reach the KadeWe, the Kurfürstendamm and the City West. The well-known Winterfeldplatz with many small shops and the year-round weekly market on Wednesdays and Saturdays is only 1 kilometer away.

The apartment is located on subway line 4 with connections to subway lines U1, U2 and U3 (Nollendorfplatz) as well as U7 at Bayerischer Platz. You can reach the S-Bahn lines via the U 4 at Innsbrucker Platz. Parking spaces are usually available on the street. The Südkreuz train station, the city motorway and Tegel Airport are easily accessible from Schöneberg.

About This Property

Fully equipped apartment on the mezzanine floor of an old Berlin building near Viktoria-Luise-Platz in the Bavarian Quarter, 10 minutes walk to Ku'Damm. With great attention to detail, you live in a completely renovated apartment on 38 square meters.

In the execution, particular emphasis was placed on the use of ecological materials and sustainability. A tailor-made kitchen and designer furniture from Vitra and USM round off the living experience.
Original herringbone parquet and floorboards are in the kitchen, hallway and bedroom. The bathroom is equipped with natural stone. Large window fronts with shutters and curtains ensure a bright room experience.

The apartment with a ceiling height of 3.40 m offers you sophisticated fittings with plenty of storage space and very high-quality equipment for cooking, sleeping, relaxing and working. Bathroom furnishings, furniture, lighting and accessories are carefully selected. The kitchen has a ceramic hob, dishwasher, refrigerator and a Miele oven. You sleep on a 140 cm wide organic slatted frame, a natural latex mattress in organic cotton bed covers.

You can expect an Entertain TV, VDSL Internet and WiFi. Kitchen appliances, kettle, toaster, washing machine (Miele), iron and much more are included. The rental price includes all additional costs and includes cleaning twice a week. The final cleaning will be charged additionally.

description:
Stilvoll eingerichtete 52 m2 Wohnung in Tempelhof. Die große Wohnküche sowie das das Schlafzimmer, bieten Platz für zwei Personen.

Die Wohnung befindet sich zwischen dem Tempelhofer Feld und dem Tempelhofer Hafen. Die U6 ist 6 min von der Wohnung entfernt.

title: Rudolstädter Straße, Berlin
description:
Lage: 
Diese komplett möblierte Wohnung liegt direkt neben einem Park im Herzen von Wilmersdorf und bietet vom Balkon aus einen wunderschönen Parkblick. Der Park ist nur eine Minute entfernt und eignet sich ideal zum Joggen. Die U-Bahn-Station (U3) sowie die S-Bahn-Stationen (S41, S42, S46), Heidelberger Platz, sind nur 5 Gehminuten entfernt, und in der Nähe gibt es Supermärkte für den täglichen Bedarf. Ein öffentliches Schwimmbad und ein Krankenhaus sind ebenfalls nur 5 Gehminuten entfernt. 

Ausstattung: 
Die möblierte Wohnung verfügt über ein Schlafzimmer, ein Wohnzimmer mit Balkon, ein Badezimmer mit Badewanne und eine Küche mit Backofen, Herd, Kühlschrank, Waschmaschine und Küchenschränken.

Wenn zusätzliche Parkplätze benötigt werden, stehen ausreichend Parkplätze auf der Straße zur Verfügung. Außerdem gibt es einen Kellerraum, der auch zur Wohnung gehört. WLAN is in der Miete enthalten. 

Diese Wohnung bietet einen großartigen Parkblick, eine einfache Anbindung an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr, nahegelegene Geschäfte sowie die Nähe zu einem Schwimmbad und einem Krankenhaus - ein komfortabler und praktischer Ort, den man sein Zuhause nennen kann.

title: Paderborner Straße, Berlin
description:
Altbauwohnung mit 100 qm Privatgarten nahe Ku’damm -Erstbezug nach Sanierung 

Zentrale 3-Zimmer-Wohnung mit Garten in Berlin-Wilmersdorf! Ruhig gelegen in einer Seitenstraße, bietet sie modernes Design, helle Räume und einen privaten Garten. Urbanes Wohnen trifft hier auf entspannte Atmosphäre. U7 in unmittelbarer Nähe, sowie zahlreiche Einkaufsmöglichkeiten und Cafés.
Nach einer umfassenden Sanierung erstrahlt diese Wohnung in neuem Glanz – Erstbezug nach Renovierung! Moderne Ausstattung: 55-Zoll-Fernseher, Küche  mit Markengeräten, Waschmaschine, getrennter Kühl- und Gefrierschrank. Der pflegeleichte Garten mit großzügiger Terrasse (automatische Bewässerungsanlage) bietet Privatsphäre, da er von der Straße aus nicht einsehbar ist.

Im Badezimmer erwartet Sie ein modernes Ambiente und höchster Komfort. Die Küche beeindruckt mit hochwertigen Markengeräten, die das Kochen zum Vergnügen machen. Diese Wohnung vereint stilvolle Eleganz mit zeitgemäßem Komfort – ein perfektes Zuhause im Herzen der City West.

title: Oehlertring, Berlin
description:
Very bright and quiet flat. The flat is located in a very quiet street, a dead end. 5 minutes away is the S-Bahn station "Priesterweg" and bus stops. One stop further away is the S-Bahn station Südkreuz from where you have connections in all directions. Potsdamer Platz is 4 stops away from Priesterweg.
A few minutes from the house is the beautiful Insulaner park and a swimming pool.
There are great shopping facilities in the neighbourhood (bakery, Edeka, Lidl etc.)
The flat has underfloor heating.
There is a bedroom, living room, kitchen, bathroom and balcony. There is plenty of free parking around the house.
The balcony has about 6 square metres.
The kitchen is fully equipped: Dishwasher, cooker, oven, fridge, kettle, coffee machine, microwave, crockery,dining table, etc.
....
Sehr helle und ruhige Wohnung. Die Wohnung liegt in einer sehr ruhigen Straße, einer Sackgasse. 5 Minuten entfernt ist die S-Bahnstation "Priesterweg" und Bushaltestellen. Eine Station weiter entfernt ist die S-Bahn Station Südkreuz von wo aus man in alle Richtungen Verbindungen hat. Vom Priesterweg ist Potsdamer Platz 4 Stationen entfernt.
Wenige Minuten vom Haus entfernt ist der schöne Park Insulaner und ein Schwimmbad.
Es gibt tolle Einkaufsmöglichkeiten in der Umgebung (Bäcker, Edeka, Lidl etc.)
Die Wohnung hat Fußbodenheizung.
Es gibt ein Schlafzimmer, Wohnzimmer, Küche, Bad und Balkon. Um das Haus herum gibt es genügend kostenlose Parkmöglichkeiten.
Der Balkon hat ca. 6 qm.
Die Küche ist voll eingerichtet: Geschirrspüler, Herd, Backofen, Kühlschrank, Wasserkocher, Kaffeemaschine, Mikrowelle, Geschirr,Esstisch, etc.

title: Pfalzburger Straße, Berlin

Das Apartment verfügt über ein zusätzliches Gästebadezimmer, Parkettboden, Handtücher und Bettzeug (ausreichend vorhanden) sowie ein Schlafsofa im Wohnzimmer,

title: Mühlenstraße, Berlin
description:
Die komplett möblierte, 3-Zimmerwohnung mit 2 Bädern liegt in Top-Lage direkt neben der East Side Gallery und Mercedes-Benz Arena. 

Die Wohnung liegt im 4. Stock des neu gebauten Pure Living Gebäudes mit einem Concierge Service, großzügigem Eingangsbereich, 4 Aufzügen und ruhigem Innenhof.

Die Wohnung bietet eine gesamte Fläche vom 72m2. Sie hat 2 Schlafzimmer, einen großen Balkon und ein Wohn-Esszimmer mit moderner Wohnküche, die mit Kühlschrank, Gefrierschrank, Spülmaschine, Kaffeemaschine und vielen nützliche Utensilien für Ihren täglichen Bedarf ausgestattet ist. 

Der Wohn-Esszimmer Bereich ist mit einem gemütlichen 3-Sitz-Sofa, Couchtisch, Sideboard und einem 55Zoll Flachbildfernseher eingerichtet. 

Die beiden Schlafzimmer sind mit jeweils einem 1,8x2m Bett incl. Bettkasten, einem 2m breiten Kleiderschrank mit einer Spiegelschiebertür und Softeinzug möbliert. Die 3 Fach verglasten bodentiefen Holz-Fenster, welche sich zum schön gepflegten Innenhof richtet, sorgen für ruhige Nächte und Entspannung, falls man dem bewegten Leben entfliehen möchte. Von Straßenlärm oder den häufigen Veranstaltungen ist nichts zu hören.

Die beiden hellbeleuchteten Badzimmer verfügt über jeweils eine Grohe Regendusche, WC und einen sehr großen Spiegel. Der Waschtrockner befindet sich in einem der Badzimmer. Bettwäsche und Handtücher sind ebenfalls vorhanden.

Zur U-Bahn und S-Bahn Station Warschauer Straße und zum Berlin Ostbahnhof sind es ca. 700m. In ca. 400m Entfernung befindet sich die East-Side-Mall mit zahlreichen Geschäften für das tägliche Leben und einem Fitnessstudio.  In direkter Nachbarschaft sind zahlreiche Lokale und eine Bäckerei zu finden.

title: Salzburger Straße, Berlin
description:
Luxurious apartment with exclusive design (recently renovated) in top location on Bayerischer Platz

Location:  
This elegant apartment is centrally located in Schöneberg and borders directly on Bayerischer Platz with excellent subway connections (U4 and U7). You live in a quiet, tree-lined side street, surrounded by the magnificent old buildings of middle-class Berlin.

Surroundings:  
The perfect infrastructure offers all stores for daily needs in the immediate vicinity. The popular weekly market at Rathaus Schöneberg is within sight and invites you to shop and linger. The Akazienkiez and the popular market on Winterfeldtplatz are within walking distance. The Kurfürstendamm can be reached by bike in under 10 minutes. There is also an S-Bahn connection and various bus lines in the immediate vicinity. Popular restaurants and bars are also within walking distance.

Highlights:  
- Freshly renovated, high-quality apartment in first occupancy
- Completely refurbished and furnished with high-quality materials
- Quiet location in a charming side street
- Elegant old buildings characterize the residential area

title: Schaperstraße, Berlin
description:
Renting a furnished room with kitchen and bathroom during the Month of August. Available to move in from July 29th. 
From November 1st, available for longer term.
All utilities included. The room is super fresh and very peaceful. The apartment location is 2 blocks from Kudamm in a quiet street. U-Bahn and buses around the corner.
Looking for a smoke and drug free, super decent person. A background check and criminal check is required.

title: Johanniterstraße, Berlin
description:
Experience the unique charm of Kreuzberg in this cozy 1-room flat, stylishly furnished for comfort and flair. Equipped with a TV and snug furnishings, it's the ideal retreat for relaxation. The space is versatile, perfect for both living and a home office setup.

Located right at Hallesches Tor and Landwehrkanal, it offers a peaceful haven amidst the vibrant neighborhood. Mehringdamm with its many stores and restaurants is just a few minutes' walk away.

You will have quick connections to all of Berlin since two U-Bahn lines are crossing. Several bus routes and the U-Bahn lines U1, U3, and U6 are within walking distance. So, you can travel both east-west and north-south very conveniently.

title: Prinzregentenstraße, Berlin
description: Die Wohnung ist frisch renoviert und mit hochwertigen Möbeln in eleganten Beige-/Grau-/Weißtönen ausgestattet (siehe Bilder). Sie befindet sich relativ weit oben, so dass man aus den Fenstern und vom Balkon einen wunderschönen Blick auf den Park hat und einem niemand rein schauen kann. Für die Arbeit ist ein großer Flachbildfernseher an der Wand über dem Schreibtisch montiert, der sowohl als Arbeitsbildschirm (mit dem Laptop verbunden) als auch als normaler Smart-TV genutzt werden kann (du kannst dich mit deinem eigenen Netflix- oder Prime-Konto einloggen). Das Badezimmer ist sehr schön und verfügt über eine Miele-Waschmaschine. Die Küche ist ebenfalls hochwertig ausgestattet. Ein großer Supermarkt ist gleich um die Ecke. Geeignet für Projektarbeiter oder Paare mit einer Projektlaufzeit von 6-12 Monaten in Berlin. Der Park lädt zum Joggen ein oder für Picknick im Sommer.

title: Wilhelmshöher Straße, Berlin
description:
Großzügige 4-Zimmer-Wohnung mit insgesamt ca. 115 qm , 2 Zimmer sind der Vermieterin vorbehalten (Nutzung nur alle paar Wochen ein paar Tage durch den Sohn der Vermieterin mit Vorankündigung - ansonsten hat man die Wochnung für sich allein). • Berliner Zimmer mit Esstisch (ausziehbar) + 4 Stühle, Chippendale Sofa + Sesseln und großer Bibliothek
• Bad mit Dusch/Badewannenkombination und Waschmaschine

• Hohem Bücherregal
• Schöner, weicher Teppich (neu) 
• Kleiner Balkon-Tisch mit zwei Stühlen

title: Nestorstraße, Berlin
description:
Make yourself at home in this bright and welcoming studio! Designed with care, this apartment offers a private sanctuary in one of Berlin’s most sought-after districts. From the plush bedsheets to the fully stocked kitchenware, every detail has been handled so you can focus on enjoying the city.

With the U-Bahn and Ring Bahn just a short stroll away, all of Berlin is at your fingertips—though with so many cute cafes and restaurants right on your doorstep, you might never want to leave the neighborhood!

title: Eisenzahnstraße, Berlin
description:

title: Feurigstraße, Berlin
description:

title: Ringstraße, Berlin
description: This stylishly renovated and fully furnished one-room apartment is located on the top floor of a well-kept residential building in a quiet area – featuring a sunny balcony and a beautiful view of the greenery.  Situated in a sought-after neighborhood, the apartment is just a 15 minutes bus ride away from the Freie Universität of Berlin (FU), and in walking distance to the Charité Campus Benjamin Franklin, BSP Business & Law School and the Federal Institute for Materials Research and Testing.  Perfect for students, young professionals, or commuters – with a modern fitted kitchen, high-quality bathroom, and tasteful furnishings.

title: Geisbergstraße, Berlin
description:
Fashionable & cozy home in Schöneberg
A listed post office from the 1920s has awoken from its slumber. Enjoy a living without obstacles: the apartment, the corresponding storage room in the basement, the bicycle room as well as the underground parking space can be reached via the staircase with an elevator. Central meeting point for all residents is a common room - the old counter hall. Directly adjacent are the inner courtyards and a separate fitness room. In the counter hall you will also find the concierge team, whose services you are welcome to use. The loft is fully furnished. This includes an open, modern kitchen with a central cooking island, a box spring bed with bed base, a large sliding door wardrobe, a sofa bed, TV and other furniture. Live in one of Berlin's most popular residential areas - right in the heart of the city between KaDeWe and Rathaus Schöneberg. In the immediate vicinity is the popular Viktoria-Luise-Platz with its small park and nice cafés and restaurants.

A parking space in the underground garage belongs to the apartment. Your own bicycles can be easily stored in the specially designed bicycle room. A viewing is possible by appointment. Liability insurance is a prerequisite.

title: Kurfürstenstraße, Berlin
description:
Our comfortable apartment features a separate bedroom and an open living/eating space. The apartment is fully equipped to make your stay a most enjoyable one.

The bedroom contains a king-size bed with two separate mattresses (200 x 90 cm). It faces the quiet, green back yard.
For your special convenience we provide extra large comforters (220 x 155 cm).

The spacious living/eating space (approx. 50 sqm) features two comfortable sofas and faces a quiet garden.

The modern kitchen is fully equipped (incl. a modern stove, dishwasher, fridge with freezing compartment, coffeemaker, toaster, electric water kettle etc.) and interacts with the open living/eating space.

The bathroom contains a bathtub with shower, WC, washbasin and a washer/dryer.

The apartment is situated very centrally on the border of the districts Tiergarten, Kreuzberg and Schoeneberg. 

The Potsdamer Platz with its array of offices, shops, restaurants, cinemas, theatres, museums as well as the Philharmonic is only a 10 mins walk away. You can relax in the new Gleisdreieck park, which is a mere 70 metres away or you can cicle 10 minutes to the idyllic Tiergarten park. 

From the Kurfuerstenstrasse U-Bahn station you can easily reach the famous KaDeWe department store at Wittenberg Platz which is only 2 subway stations away. 
Bahnhof Zoo and the zoological gardens are only 3 subway stops away.

Public transport is available at the Kurfuerstenstraße (U1) or at the Buelowstrasse (U2) U-Bahn stations, both some 200 m from the apartment. A 7 mins. taxi ride will take you to the Hauptbahnhof train station, which gives easy access to the German high speed rail net as well as both Berlin airports.

Metered parking is available in the street.

title: Birkbuschstraße, Berlin
description: Fully furnished apartment near S Rathaus Steglitz. Features a balcony, separate bedroom and living room, a compact bedroom, and a mid-sized kitchen. Ideal for one person or a couple.

title: Gersdorfstraße, Berlin
description:
🏡 Lots of Space or Smart and Cozy? Your Apartment, Your Style.

Looking for a place that fits your life – not the other way around? Whether you prefer a spacious layout with a separate bedroom and study, or love the efficiency of a perfectly designed one-bedroom, you'll find your ideal match here. Every apartment is uniquely crafted – sometimes larger, sometimes more compact, always thoughtfully designed.

🛏️ Studio SMART BUDGET
Smartly designed and perfectly optimized: the Studio SMART BUDGET makes the most of every square meter. Sleep, work, cook, and live – all in one thoughtfully arranged space, without compromise. Starting from 19m2, with a bed size of 120x200cm, this layout offers maximum function in a compact form. Ideal for anyone who wants to live smart and efficiently.

⚡ Smart Living, Seamless Comfort
High-speed internet is included in your rent – no setup stress, just plug in and go. Your digital apartment key? It’s already in your pocket – store it on your smartphone or carry it as a handy keychain tag.

🧺 Everyday Life, Made Easy
Skip the bulky appliances – use our in-house We-Wash laundry service. Track machine availability through the app and get notified when your laundry is ready.
Love to cycle? Keep your bike safe in the secure bike garage on-site.

Need a break or a brainstorming spot? Head to the community space in the back building – perfect for meetups, co-working, or relaxed evenings. (Opening November)
Or enjoy fresh air in the shared garden and courtyard – your urban retreat. (Open from October)

📦 Moving In? Let Us Handle the Details
Rent kitchenware – from pots and pans to crockery – and we’ll have everything ready before you arrive.

- Supermarket – directly opposite

- Kebab stand – also directly opposite
- Späti – 2 minutes away

- U-Bahn (U6, Westphalweg) – 8 minutes away

Happy to host you!

title: Stindestraße, Berlin
description:
This freshly renovated 1-room apartment is located on a quiet, tree-lined street in Berlin-Steglitz, just steps away from the beautiful Stadtpark Steglitz. Fully furnished in a modern style, it features a sleek bathroom, a fully equipped fitted kitchen, and a bright south-facing balcony — perfect for relaxing or working from home. The apartment is heated with energy-efficient district heating, and a photovoltaic system for green energy will be installed by the end of the year.

The location offers a perfect mix of nature, convenience, and accessibility. The apartment is within walking distance of major bus lines and the S-Bahn station “Südende,” providing quick connections to central Berlin. The U9 underground line (U-Bahn) is also nearby via Rathaus Steglitz. The Freie Universität Berlin can be reached in about 15 minutes by public transport or bike, making this an ideal spot for students, researchers, or professionals working at the university.

The surrounding area has everything you need: supermarkets, bakeries, cozy cafés, and one of Berlin’s best shopping districts — Schloßstraße — with a wide range of stores, restaurants, and entertainment options. Right next door is the large Stadtpark Steglitz, offering green space for walks, jogging, or simply relaxing outdoors.

This apartment combines comfort, sustainability, and an excellent location — a perfect home base in one of Berlin’s most pleasant neighborhoods.

title: Gotenstraße, Berlin
description:
This light-flooded apartment is available for temporary use and offers everything you need for a comfortable stay in Berlin. High-quality designer furniture, stylish furnishings and a first-class location make it the perfect temporary home.

Location: Quiet, charming & perfectly connected

The apartment is located in Schöneberger Linse, south of Rote Insel, one of Berlin's most exciting neighborhoods. Here, historical charm is combined with modern city life. Just a few minutes' walk away is Cheruskerpark, a green oasis for relaxing or exercising.
Just one S-Bahn stop further on, Tempelhofer Feld invites you to take long walks, go jogging or enjoy a relaxing picnic - one of Berlin's largest open spaces right on your doorstep!

The surrounding area also offers excellent infrastructure:

Top connections: Südkreuz station is within easy reach - with ICE, S-Bahn and bus connections in all directions.
Fitness & shopping: A FitX studio is just around the corner, as is IKEA for all your shopping needs.
Lively neighborhood: The Akazienkiez with its cozy cafés, restaurants and small boutiques is just a short walk away.

Highlights of the apartment:
✔ Bright rooms with large windows
✔ Fully furnished with stylish design classics
✔ Top location in Schöneberger Linse, close to Rote Insel
✔ Perfect connections: Südkreuz, S-Bahn, buses in the immediate vicinity
✔ Good leisure options: Cheruskerpark, Tempelhofer Feld, FitX, Akazienkiez
✔ Short-term & flexible rental possible

Move in, feel good, experience Berlin - ideal for professionals, expats or project stays.

title: Weimarische Straße, Berlin
description:

	•	Fully renovated and freshly refurbished historic apartment
	•	2nd floor (with elevator)
	•	90m2 living space
	•	3 rooms + south-facing winter garden in Spanish style
	•	3.30 m high ceilings with stucco and plenty of natural light.
• Well-preserved historic building from 1906 

Features:

	•	Spacious bathroom with premium marble tiles, equipped with bathtub, shower, and bidet of the premium brand Duvarit and underfloor heating
	•	Separate guest WC
	•	Fully furnished
	•	Private basement storage unit

title: Mühlenstraße, Berlin
description:
Fully furnished 3-room apartment with registration (Anmeldung) for working professionals in a new building near a park

The flat has three nice rooms: 2 bedrooms, a living room with a kitchen, a bathroom with a shower and washing machine, and a balcony.
New build with underfloor heating, deep floor windows with roller shutter and parquet flooring. The flat is modern and fully furnished with a fitted kitchen with dishwasher, refrigerator, coffee machine, stove and oven,  crockery and cooking utensils, and bed linen and towels are provided.
The flat is located near the Lankwitz S-Bahn (15 minutes on foot or 2 bus stops), very close to a park, with a playground in the courtyard.

title: Manteuffelstraße, Berlin
description:
✔️ Spacious historic Altbau apartment in Berlin with modern comforts
✔️ Fully furnished 2-room layout with separate kitchen/dining area and bathroom
✔️ High-quality kitchen with Siemens appliances and ample storage
✔️ Comfortable bedroom with bed linens, pillows, blankets, and wardrobe
✔️ Washing machine, WiFi, TV, and workspace included

🛋️ The Apartment
This fully renovated Altbau apartment combines historic charm with modern living. The bathroom features a shower and heated towel rack, while the kitchen includes a dishwasher, stove, oven, refrigerator, and kettle. Additional amenities such as a coffee machine, desk/workspace, and door intercom system make it perfect for long-term stays or city living. Stunning parquet flooring and updated utilities ensure a cozy, move-in-ready home, and the apartment offers a beautiful view of Bosepark.

📍 Location & Connectivity
Located on the front side of a classic 1900 building, the apartment provides convenient access to public transportation, making it easy to explore all that Berlin has to offer.

🏙️ Ideal For
Professionals, couples, or small families seeking a spacious, historic apartment with modern amenities in a prime Berlin location.

description:
Über dieses Angebot

description:
The room on offer is approximately 25 m2 and is part of a beautiful historic apartment with a total living space of around 200 m2. It is spacious, very bright, and features high ceilings, herringbone parquet floors, and classic double doors.

The room is fully furnished with a comfortable sofa bed, but it can also be rented unfurnished if you prefer to bring your own furniture.

You’ll have your own private bathroom, used exclusively by you – ideal for anyone who values privacy and comfort. The shared apartment also includes an impressive library in English manor style, with dark wood and a cozy atmosphere – perfect for reading, working, or simply relaxing.

The apartment is located in the heart of Charlottenburg, one of the most beautiful and sought-after neighborhoods in Berlin. In the immediate area, you’ll find numerous cafés, restaurants, boutiques, and Charlottenburg Palace Park. Public transport connections (bus, U-Bahn, and S-Bahn) are excellent – all just a few minutes away. The Kurfürstendamm and City West can easily be reached on foot or by bike.

You’ll be sharing the apartment with me – I’m 53 years old, self-employed, and work mostly from home. I appreciate a quiet, harmonious living environment and value mutual respect, openness, and cleanliness.

Also living here is Woody, my 6-year-old Cocker Spaniel. He tends to be a bit reserved with new people and needs some time to build trust – but once he gets to know you, he’s friendly and relaxed.

The shared spaces – kitchen, living room, and library – are used and maintained by both of us. A clean and pleasant home is important to me.

I’m looking for a friendly, easy-going, and considerate person who fits well into a calm, respectful atmosphere and appreciates the unique charm of this historic apartment.

I’m Danish and have lived in Berlin for eight years – the city has truly become my home. If you’re an open and warm-hearted person looking for a beautiful place to feel comfortable, you’ll likely feel at home here very quickly.

Kitchen, bath, hallway + three large rooms (one actual bedroom, one dining room, and one combined living and office room), and a balcony. Total size is 116qm (~1300 sq ft).

Third floor (with elevator) in European counting (fourth floor using U.S. counting), front side of building (Vorderhaus), facing the quiet neighborhood street, in a five-floor building.

Spacious kitchen with all the facilities and tools you need. One quirk: The washing machine is also installed in the kitchen.

The bathroom features both a bathtub and a separate shower.

The spacious hallway can be reached from the outside through a steel-plated door (with safety keys).

The apartment pretty much has anything you need. There are parking spots for bicycles in the inner yard, but no parking spots for cars (there is plenty of street parking available, though.)

The apartment has a washing machine, but no dryer. I hang my clothes on a standing rack to dry over night and it works just fine.

No smoking, no pets (robots are fine, though). No remodeling or permanent changes to the apartment, please.

I will make sufficient room available for your clothing and personal effects. Please let me know how much space you need.

This beautifully designed 3-room architect’s apartment in the popular Berlin district of Steglitz offers 82 m2 of refined living space plus a separate kitchen. Combining classic Altbau charm with modern comfort, the light-filled apartment enjoys lovely views over the greenery of Stadtpark Steglitz and is nestled in a quiet residential area on the 2.5th floor, with green views on both sides.

The layout is thoughtfully designed for flexible living:
The master bedroom features a king-size bed, elegant built-in wardrobe, direct access to the balcony, and tranquil garden views.
The living room / second bedroom offers a high-quality queen-size sofa bed and can be used as a lounge or guest room.
The third room combines a dining area with a dedicated workspace, ideal for home office use with views of greenery.

The apartment is rented fully furnished with high-end, custom-made fixtures, including a bespoke kitchen, built-in wardrobes in the hallway and bedroom, and a custom shelving unit in the living room that complements the apartment’s period character. High-speed internet (1,000 Mbit/s) makes it especially attractive for freelancers or remote workers.

A private balcony provides a peaceful spot to relax, while residents also enjoy access to a shared inner courtyard garden and bicycle cellar. Free parking is available on the quiet side streets in the neighborhood.

The renovated, separate kitchen is fully equipped with custom cabinetry, induction cooktop with extractor hood, refrigerator, oven, and dishwasher. An adjoining storage room houses the washing machine. The stylish, like-new bathroom features both a bathtub and a separate shower, combining comfort and functionality.

Available fully furnished from April 1st, 2026, the apartment is offered on a fixed-term lease of one to four years—ideal for families, small shared households, or professionals seeking a calm, high-quality living environment close to nature yet well connected to the city.

Your new home is located in the heart of Berlin-Steglitz, one of the city’s most sought-after yet pleasantly tranquil residential areas. Here, urban living blends seamlessly with a green and relaxed environment. Shops for everyday needs, charming cafés, and a diverse selection of restaurants are all within easy walking distance. Right on your doorstep, Stadtpark Steglitz offers expansive green spaces, picnic lawns, playgrounds, and a restaurant—perfect for relaxing walks and leisure activities.

Excellent public transport connections (bus, S-Bahn, and U-Bahn nearby) provide quick and easy access to Berlin’s city center and all major districts. At the same time, you can enjoy the calm of an established residential neighborhood characterized by elegant period buildings, stately villas, tennis clubs, and a very well-developed infrastructure. Numerous private and public schools, medical practices, and hospitals are located in the surrounding area. The popular shopping street Schloßstraße can be reached within minutes. title: Berliner Straße, Berlin
description:
The BRUTUS apartment is a fully renovated, high-quality studio located in the sought-after district of Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf, just a few minutes from the famous Ku’damm boulevard. Combining modern design with thoughtful functionality, this apartment offers a comfortable and stylish living experience in one of Berlin’s most attractive areas.
The studio has been completely refurbished and furnished to a high standard, with a strong focus on quality, comfort, and attention to detail. The living area features a spacious and comfortable sofa bed (160x200 cm) with a high-quality mattress, ensuring excellent sleep quality whether for short or longer stays. A large wardrobe, additional storage space, and a 55-inch smart TV with international channels provide everything needed for a relaxed and convenient lifestyle.
The fully equipped kitchen includes premium AEG appliances such as an induction cooktop, an oven with integrated microwave function, and a washer-dryer. In addition, all essential kitchen equipment is provided, including a coffee machine, toaster, and complete cookware, making the apartment ready for immediate use.
The modern bathroom is fitted with high-end Hansgrohe fixtures and designed to a premium standard. Additional amenities such as a hairdryer and steamer are available, ensuring maximum comfort for everyday living.
Located on the 1st floor in a quiet courtyard building, the apartment offers a peaceful atmosphere despite its central location. The U-Bahn station Fehrbelliner Platz is only a 5-minute walk away, providing excellent connections to all parts of the city.
High-speed internet (250 Mbit) is included, making the apartment ideal for remote work, streaming, and everyday use.
Digital access via Nuki smart lock for convenient and secure check-in.
The BRUTUS apartment stands out through its above-average level of equipment and thoughtful setup, offering significantly more comfort than typical market listings. It is the perfect choice for anyone looking for a fully equipped, modern, and centrally located home in Berlin.

title: Naumannstraße, Berlin
description:
🌿 Family Home in Berlin-Schöneberg (3–6 Months, Fully Furnished)

Bright, spacious maisonette apartment in one of Berlin’s most beautiful and calm neighborhoods: Schöneberg.

Perfect for families with up to two kids who want to arrive in Berlin and feel at home immediately — without spending weeks searching in the city’s difficult housing market.

	•	Separate bedrooms + kids’ rooms
	•	Bathroom with washing machine
	•	Generous storage space
	•	Warm, personal atmosphere — a real home, not a rental setup

🌳 Location 
Located in a quiet, family-friendly area of Schöneberg:
	•	Calm streets, lots of families
	•	Cafés, supermarkets and playgrounds nearby
	•	Balcony view towards a beautiful square with a landmark church

A rare mix of peaceful living and central Berlin access.

We are a family of four (two boys) — and soon five.
That’s why we need more space and are temporarily moving out.

We truly love this home and are looking for people who will appreciate it the same way.

The central heating has had some reliability issues. To make sure the apartment stays warm and comfortable, we provide additional heating solutions throughout the space.

This is not a typical rental — it’s a lived-in family home.

Ideal if you:

	•	are coming with family and need space, calm and quality of life

Especially in summer, the apartment is something special.

title: Erdmannstraße, Berlin
description:
Experience the luxury of space in this massive 96 m2 mid-century modern loft. Located on the 4th floor of a classic Berlin Altbau, this apartment combines the grandeur of high ceilings with a minimalist, timeless design.

We provide the "Wohnungsgeberbestätigung" (landlord confirmation), allowing you to register with the city authorities (Bürgeramt) without any hassle. Ideal for expats and professionals starting their life in Berlin.

The Space:

- Expansive Living: Unlike typical Berlin studios, this 96 m2 home offers an airy, open-concept layout that separates living, dining, and sleeping areas with style and fluid movement.

- Light-Filled: Massive windows bathe the apartment in natural light, highlighting the curated mid-century furnishings.

- Fully Equipped: A chef’s kitchen with high-end appliances, premium bedding, and a dedicated workspace, perfect for professionals and creatives.

The Neighborhood:

Situated in Friedenau, one of Berlin’s best-kept secrets. Enjoy tree-lined streets, boutique cafés, and a quiet residential vibe, all while being perfectly connected to Mitte and City West via the nearby S-Bahn and U-Bahn stations.

Highlights:

- 96 m2 of private living space.

- Fast Wi-Fi & quiet environment for Home Office.

- Classic European architecture with modern comforts.

title: Brandenburgische Straße, Berlin
description:
🌟 Discover a sun-drenched and peaceful retreat in the heart of Berlin!
Situated on Brandenburgische Straße, this charming 1-room apartment offers a perfect blend of central convenience and quiet relaxation in the desirable Wilmersdorf district.

🏢 The Apartment
This inviting home is designed to maximize comfort and functional living. The layout features a fully equipped kitchen complete with modern appliances, an oven, a microwave, and all the cooking essentials you need. A major highlight is the private, sunny, southwest-facing balcony, which provides an ideal spot to unwind and soak in the afternoon sun. The bathroom is beautifully appointed with both a shower and a full bathtub, offering a relaxing sanctuary. For a seamless move-in experience, the property comes complete with practical extras like bed linen, pillows, an ironing board, and a vacuum cleaner.

🛏️ The Room
The multi-functional living and sleeping area serves as a cozy and bright retreat. Furnished to optimize space, it benefits from large windows that flood the entire room with natural warmth and light. The thoughtfully planned setup balances a comfortable sleeping space with an area perfect for dining, working, or unwinding after a busy day in the city.

🌳 The Neighborhood
The surrounding Wilmersdorf neighborhood provides a fantastic variety of lifestyle and leisure options. You are located just a short walk away from the beautiful Wilmersdorf City Park, an ideal green oasis for morning jogs or peaceful strolls. The immediate area is packed with excellent local restaurants, vibrant bars, supermarkets, and boutique cinemas. Commuting across Berlin is incredibly effortless, with a prominent U-Bahn station situated just a brief stroll from your doorstep, connecting you rapidly to Kurfürstendamm and the historic city center.

📝 Extra information
The monthly rent includes electricity costs up to a maximum of €40. Any consumption exceeding this amount will be charged at the electricity provider's rate (€0.35/kWh). Internet/DSL costs an additional €35 per month and is mandatory.
